_comment: Hinglish guides for the calculator pages, same shape as tool_guides.json. A hand-written entry under calcs wins; otherwise the category template is used, so all 101 tools get a Hinglish block. Same {name} and {desc} placeholders. Hinglish is roman script only, never Devanagari. Technical terms (EBITDA, LTV:CAC, gross margin, GST) stay in English, because that is how an Indian founder actually says them.

everyday.what: {name} un chhote sawaalon ka jawab deta hai jo har hafte aate hain — bill par kitna percent off, total ka kitna hissa, simple interest kitna. Iska maksad ye hai ki aapko calculator app, copy aur aadha-adhoora formula yaad karne ki zaroorat na pade. {desc} Sab kuch aapke browser me hi chalta hai, isliye aapka koi number kahin nahi jaata.
everyday.formula: In saare tools me ek hi ganit ka rule lagta hai, aapke daale number par. Percentage matlab hissa ko poore se divide karke 100 se guna karo. Simple interest matlab principal x rate x time. Compound interest me har period par byaaj wapas principal me jud jaata hai, isliye base badhta rehta hai. Tool rule lagata hai aur aapko result, beech ke steps, aur jahan zaroori ho wahan kul kitna dena ya milega wo bhi dikhata hai.
when: Jab aap dukaan ka bill ya online discount pay karne se pehle check kar rahe ho.
Jab aap total ka hissa nikal rahe ho — partner ka cut, deposit, ya commission.
Jab form me number likhne se pehle ek quick sanity check chahiye.
mistakes: Percentages ko jod dena. 10% badhne ke baad 10% gire to wapas wahi nahi hota — 99% reh jaata hai.
Ek saal se zyada ke liye simple interest lagana. Bank compound karte hain, isliye simple interest ka jawab kam dikhata hai.
Bahut jaldi rounding kar dena. Poora number rakho aur sirf final jawab round karo.

profit.what: {name} dikhata hai ki business asli me kitna bachata hai, sirf kitna kamata hai wo nahi. Revenue aasaan number hai aur akela sabse kam kaam ka. {desc} Ye tool costs wapas jodta hai, taki aap wo margin dekh sako jo agla order, agli hiring aur agla kharab mahina sambhalta hai.
profit.formula: Profit matlab revenue se har wo cost ghata do jo use kamane me lagi. Margin matlab wahi profit revenue se divide, percentage me. 20% margin ka matlab hai ki har rupee ki sale me bees paise aapke paas rehte hain; baaki goods, ads, salaries, fees aur tax kha jaate hain. Ek cost badlo to margin hilta hai, isliye tool har line alag-alag badalne deta hai, sirf total nahi.
when: Jab aap price set kar rahe ho aur dekhna chahte ho ki asli costs ke baad margin bachta hai ya nahi.
Jab mahina busy laga lekin bank balance nahi badla, aur aap wajah dhoondhna chahte ho.
Jab do products ya do clients compare kar rahe ho ye decide karne ke liye ki mehnat kahan lagayein.
mistakes: Revenue ko profit maan lena. 2% margin par ek crore ki sale ka matlab hai bees lakh profit — aur ek kharab mahina use mita sakta hai.
Der se aane wali costs bhool jaana: GST, marketplace fees, returns, payment-gateway charges.
Aise competitor ko dekh kar price set karna jiski costs aapko dikhti hi nahi.

val.what: {name} ek funding round ya company valuation ka ganit samjhata hai. {desc} Yahi wo numbers hain jin par founders aur investors bahas karte hain, aur zyadatar bahas inhi figures me se ek par aake rukti hai.
val.formula: Valuation matlab poori company ki tay hui keemat. Pre-money wo keemat hai naya paisa aane se pehle; post-money uske baad. Jab investor kisi stake ke liye amount daalta hai, to post-money = investment ÷ stake, aur pre-money = post-money minus investment. Revenue multiple, EBITDA multiple aur implied value — ye sab company ke apne numbers se usi price tak pahunchne ke alag tarike hain.
when: Jab aap fundraise ki taiyari kar rahe ho aur jaanna chahte ho ki aapke numbers kya kehte hain.
Jab aapke paas term sheet hai aur aap check karna chahte ho ki wo asli me kitna hissa le raha hai.
Jab aap apni valuation ko un companies se compare kar rahe ho jinhone similar round kiya.
mistakes: Stake dekhe bina valuation padhna. Zyada valuation jo aadhi company le leti hai, us se behtar hai kam valuation jo dasva hissa leti hai.
Ek fast-growing company ka revenue multiple ek slow, profitable business ke saath compare karna.
Ye bhool jaana ki post-money valuation me naya paisa shaamil hai, isliye founder ka percentage girta hai.

cust.what: {name} ek single customer ki economics naapta hai. {desc} Yahi numbers decide karte hain ki growth paisa banayegi ya jalayegi, aur serious investor sabse pehle yahi dekhta hai.
cust.formula: Customer ko laane ki lagat (CAC) matlab sales aur marketing par kharch sab kuch, divided by kitne customers mile. Lifetime value (LTV) matlab ek customer poori relationship me kitna laata hai — average order value, guna kitni baar kharidta hai, guna kitne saal rukta hai, guna aapka gross margin. LTV ko CAC se divide karo to ratio milta hai. Lagbhag 3:1 aam rule hai; 1:1 se neeche aap har naye customer par paisa gawa rahe ho.
when: Jab aap ad budget badhane wale ho aur jaanna chahte ho ki wo wapas milega ya nahi.
Jab koi channel sasta customer la raha ho aur aap jaanna chahte ho ki ye chalega ya nahi.
Jab aap pitch ki taiyari kar rahe ho aur unit-economics slide chahiye.
mistakes: LTV ke liye gross margin ki jagah revenue use karna. Customer sale laata hai, profit nahi.
CAC me sirf ad spend ginnna aur salaries, tools aur agency fees chhod dena.
Ye maan lena ki customer saalon tak rahega jab data dikhata hai ki zyadatar kuch mahine me chale jaate hain.

growth.what: {name} un do cheezon ko track karta hai jo young businesses ko maarti hain: cash khatam hona, aur cash se zyada tez badhna. {desc} Growth ek headline hai; cash oxygen hai.
growth.formula: Burn matlab wo cash jo business har mahine kamai se zyada kharch karta hai. Runway matlab aapke paas ka cash divided by wo monthly burn — yaani kitne mahine baad paisa khatam. Run rate ek period ka revenue utha kar poore saal tak scale karta hai, jo compare karne me kaam ka hai lekin maanta hai ki wo period dohrayega. Break-even wo sales level hai jahan contribution aapki fixed costs cover kar deta hai, isliye profit zero hota hai aur har extra sale profit ban jaati hai.
when: Jab aap jaanna chahte ho ki raise karne ya cut karne se pehle kitne mahine bache hain.
Jab aap decide kar rahe ho ki abhi hire karein ya ek quarter ruk jaayein.
Jab ek mahina asaadharan strong tha aur aap usse saal ke baaki hisson se theek se compare karna chahte ho.
mistakes: Runway ko revenue se naapna, bank me pade cash se nahi.
Run rate ko forecast maan lena. Ye ek snapshot hai, koi promise nahi.
Sabse pehle wahi kharch kaatna jo customers laata hai. Isse abhi runway chhota hota hai aur baad me business bhi.

pricing.what: {name} ulta chalta hai — customer jo deta hai usse le kar aapke paas kya bachta hai tak. {desc} Pricing chhote business ke paas sabse tez lever hai — per unit ek rupaya badalna seedha profit me jaata hai — aur yahi wo cheez hai jo zyadatar owners andaaze se set karte hain.
pricing.formula: Customer jo price deta hai wahan se shuru karo, phir us price aur aapke bank account ke beech ka sab kuch ghatao: marketplace commission, shipping, packaging, payment fees, returns aur discounts. Jo bacha wo aapka contribution hai. Goods ki cost ghatao to ek unit ka profit milta hai. Tool har subtraction dikhata hai taki aap dekh sako ki nuksaan kaun kar raha hai.
when: Jab aap product launch kar rahe ho aur aisa price chahiye jo asli margin de.
Jab kisi marketplace ne commission badha diya ho aur aap jaanna chahte ho ki price kitna badhega.
Jab aap discount dene wale ho aur dekhna chahte ho ki profit par kya asar padega.
mistakes: Cost plus markup se price set karna, bina dekhe ki market kitna dega.
Returns ignore karna. Kuch categories me paanch me se ek order wapas aata hai aur shipping do baar aap bharte ho.
Bina ye dekhe discount dena ki stand-still rehne ke liye kitna extra volume chahiye.

ops.what: {name} un cheezon ka price nikalta hai jo chhoti team logon par kharch karti hai. {desc} Jo salary aap tay karte ho wo hire ki cost nahi hai, aur jo invoice aap dete ho wo freelancer ki cost nahi hai.
ops.formula: Ek employee ki poori cost matlab salary plus provident fund, insurance, equipment, software, aur unhe manage karne me laga samay. Freelancer ke liye, rate guna ghante, plus briefing aur revision me gaye ghante. Utilisation — paid ghanton me se kitne asli me billable hain — yahi decide karta hai ki team paisa banati hai ya nahi.
when: Jab aap pehli hiring karne wale ho aur asli monthly commitment jaanna chahte ho.
Jab aap freelancer ko full-time salary se compare kar rahe ho.
Jab aap jaanna chahte ho ki team ko apni cost cover karne ke liye kitne billable ghante bechne honge.
mistakes: Sirf salary ka budget banana. Poori cost aksar tay kiye number ka 1.2 se 1.4 guna hoti hai.
Ye maan lena ki freelancer har us ghante ka bill karega jiska aap paisa dete ho.
Us revenue se pehle hire kar dena jo us hire ka paisa dega.

investor.what: {name} ek investment ko investor ki nazar se dekhta hai. {desc} Founders valuation par bahut samay lagate hain aur us return par bahut kam jo paise ko kamana hai — aur asli me wahi number round close karta hai.
investor.formula: Return on investment matlab gain divided by jo daala gaya, percentage me. Multiple matlab final value divided by invest kiya amount — 3x ka matlab hai har ek rupaye par teen rupaye wapas. Annualised return us multiple ko saalana rate me badal deta hai, aur teen saal ke exit ko das saal wale se compare karne ka sirf yahi sahi tarika hai.
when: Jab aap do investments compare kar rahe ho jo alag-alag samay ke liye hold kiye gaye.
Jab aap model kar rahe ho ki aapke round ko investor ke liye samajh aane wala banane ke liye unhe kya dekhna hoga.
Jab aap check kar rahe ho ki kisi fund ka bataya return utna hi achha hai jitna sunne me lagta hai.
mistakes: Holding period ke bina multiples compare karna. Teen saal me 3x, das saal me 3x se behtar hai.
Dilution ignore karna. Aapka multiple us stake par hai jo abhi aapke paas hai, poori company par nahi.
Paper valuation ko cash maan lena. Ye return tab hai jab koi kharidta hai.

bonus.what: {name} ek pitch ko unhi checks se guzarta hai jo ek investor lagata. {desc} Ye rehearsal hai, faisla nahi — maksad ye hai ki kamzor number meeting se pehle mil jaaye.
bonus.formula: Pitch ka har figure ek range ke against score hota hai jise investors normal maante hain: growth un companies ke against jo similar hain, margin category ke against, runway us samay ke against jo raise me lagta hai, aur ask us traction ke against jo use justify karta hai. Tool scores jodta hai aur un lines ke naam batata hai jo total ko neeche kheenchti hain.
when: Jab aapke paas deck hai aur bhejne se pehle dusri raay chahiye.
Jab aap pitch ki practice kar rahe ho aur jaanna chahte ho ki kaunsi slide sawaal kheenchengi.
Jab aap decide kar rahe ho ki raise ke liye taiyaar ho ya ek quarter rukein.
mistakes: Kam score ko rejection samajh lena. Ye un cheezon ki list hai jinhe theek karna ya samjhana hai.
Inputs ko tune karte rehna jab tak score achha na lage, jo poore maksad ko hi khatam kar deta hai.
Sabse kamzor line ko ignore karna kyunki total zyada hai.

agency.what: {name} client work chalane ki economics cover karta hai. {desc} Agencies do cheezon par fail hoti hain: bahut zyada unbilled time, aur aise clients jo naye aane se pehle chale jaate hain.
agency.formula: Profit matlab jo fees aap bill karte ho minus kaam deliver karne ki cost, jo zyadatar logon ka samay hoti hai. Utilisation matlab billable ghante divided by available ghante. Churn matlab gaye clients divided by shuru ke clients, aur churn rate ek mota-andaza bhi deta hai ki client kitna samay rukta hai. Tool ye sab dikhata hai taki aap dekh sako ki leak kahan hai.
when: Jab aap retainer ka price de rahe ho aur quote karne se pehle margin jaanna chahte ho.
Jab mahina bhara hua laga lekin profit patla nikla.
Jab aap jaanna chahte ho ki jaane wale clients ki jagah lene ke liye kitne naye jeetne honge.
mistakes: Monthly cost se retainer quote karna, bina unbilled revision rounds ka hisaab rakhe.
Client ko permanent maan lena. 3% monthly churn par, do saal se kam me aadhe chale jaate hain.
Kaam ke kul ghante ginna, billable ghanton ki jagah.

realestate.what: {name} property kharidne ya kiraye par dene ke numbers chalata hai. {desc} Property zyadatar families ki sabse badi kharid hoti hai, aur jo costs logon ko chauka deti hain wo registration ke din bharni padti hain.
realestate.formula: Kharidne ki cost matlab price plus stamp duty, registration aur koi brokerage. Rental yield matlab saalana kiraya divided by property ki cost, percentage me. Sale par return matlab sale price minus purchase price aur costs, divided by jo paisa aapne daala. Loan tasveer badal deta hai: EMI me byaaj shaamil hota hai, isliye shuru ki payments principal ko mushkil se kam karti hain.
when: Jab aap do properties compare kar rahe ho aur dekhna chahte ho ki kaunsi zyada kamati hai.
Jab aap jaanna chahte ho ki registration ke din kitna cash chahiye, sirf price nahi.
Jab aap kharidne aur kiraye par rehne ke beech decide kar rahe ho.
mistakes: Stamp duty aur registration bhool jaana, jo mil kar price me 6% se 8% tak jod dete hain.
Gross rent ko EMI se compare karna. Rent maintenance, tax aur vacancy se pehle hota hai.
Ye maan lena ki prices sirf badhti hain, aur ek slow saal ke liye jagah na chhodna.

taxwealth.what: {name} tax aur long-term saving ke figures ka andaaza deta hai. {desc} Rules badalte rehte hain, aur alag-alag income ko alag tarah treat karte hain, isliye ye tools ek fixed jawab ki jagah ganit dikhate hain.
taxwealth.formula: Income tax slab by slab nikalta hai: rate sirf aapki income ke us hisse par lagta hai jo us band me aata hai, poore amount par nahi. Deductions us income ko kam karte hain jis par slabs lagte hain. Savings me, future value matlab jo aap daalte ho plus us par mila byaaj ya return, aur agar returns reinvest ho rahe hain to wo compound hote hain. Tool dikhata hai ki aap kul kitna daalte ho aur wo kitna ban jaata hai, taki aap split dekh sako.
when: Jab aap purane aur naye tax regime ke beech choose kar rahe ho.
Jab aap jaanna chahte ho ki monthly saving das ya bees saal me kitni ban jaati hai.
Jab aap payslip ya Form 16 ko rules ke against check kar rahe ho.
mistakes: Ye maan lena ki zyada slab aapki poori income par wahi rate lagata hai. Aisa nahi hota.
Tax-free option ko taxed option se compare karna, bina tax ka hisaab rakhe.
Projected return ko guaranteed maan lena.

dailyfun.what: {name} site ke halke-phulke tools me se ek hai. {desc} Ye maze ke liye hai — ek sawaal ka jaldi jawab jiska aapke paise se koi lena-dena nahi.
dailyfun.formula: Ye tools apne-apne published rule follow karte hain — naam par based pairing, date ka ganit, ya number ko shabdon me likhna. Isme koi financial formula nahi hai aur kuch bhi store nahi hota.
when: Jab aap curious ho aur jaldi jawab chahiye.
Jab aap doston ke saath ek dosti ka sawaal nipta na chahte ho.
Jab aap doston ke saath kuch share karna chahte ho.
mistakes: Ek fun result ke bharose asli decision lena.
Kisi bhi tarah ke fun score ko salah samajh lena.

agefun.what: Age Calculator date of birth se exact age years aur months me nikaalta hai — us tarah se ginta hai jaise form ya application ginti hai, birthday card ki tarah nahi. Ye sawaal nipatata hai ki aaj ki date par aapne diye gaye saal poore kiye hain ya nahi — wahi figure jo school admission cut-off, sarkari form, pension ya age-limited account ki eligibility tay karta hai. Kyunki ye aaj ki date par chalta hai, ye aaj ki umar deta hai, isliye ek hi janm-tithi birthday se pehle aur baad me alag jawab deti hai.
agefun.formula: Age in years = aaj ka saal minus birth year, aur ek kam tab jab is saal ka birthday abhi aaya na ho. Age in months = 12 x years + pichhle birthday ke baad ke poore mahine. Calculator din, mahina aur saal — teenon compare karta hai, isliye February ya month-end ka birthday bhi sahi handle hota hai, har mahine ko 30 din maan kar nahi.
when: Jab aap koi form bhar rahe ho jisme poore saal poochhe gaye hain aur exact figure chahiye.
Jab aap school, exam ya kisi scheme ka age cut-off kisi fixed date par check kar rahe ho.
Jab aapko kisi document ya application ke liye years aur months me exact umar chahiye.
mistakes: Saal ghata kar ye bhool jaana ki is saal birthday aaya ya nahi, jisse umar zyada dikhti hai.
Agle birthday tak round up karna jab form poore saal maangta hai.
Cut-off date ke liye mota-moti birth-year-plus-thoda use karna, jahan ek din eligibility tay karta hai.

agencycac.what: Client acquisition cost matlab aapki agency ek client jeetne par kitna kharch karti hai, aur yahi number tay karta hai ki marketing par kitna kharch kar sakte ho. Yeh sirf ad spend nahi hai - isme salesperson ki cost, woh pitches jo kahin nahi pahunchi, aur leads dhoondhne-follow karne ke tools bhi shaamil hain. Jo agency ek quarter mein 10 clients jeetne ke liye ₹5 lakh kharch karti hai, uska CAC ₹50,000 hai, aur agar woh clients apni life mein ₹2 lakh ke hain toh maths chalta hai.
agencycac.formula: CAC = (Marketing Spend + Sales Cost) ÷ New Clients. ₹4,00,000 marketing aur ₹1,00,000 sales cost se 10 clients: CAC ₹50,000. Client lifetime value se compare karo: agar LTV ₹2,00,000 hai toh ratio 4:1, jo healthy hai. 3:1 se neeche agency grow karne par zyada kharch kar rahi hai, aur har naya client cash position ko pehle kharab karta hai.
when: Marketing budget set kar rahe ho aur jaanna hai client kitne ka pad sakta hai.
Paid channels ko referrals aur outbound se compare kar rahe ho.
Check kar rahe ho ki growth actually profitable hai ya nahi.
mistakes: Sirf ad spend ginna aur sales salary aur tools bahar chhod dena.
Sab leads par divide karna, actually jeete clients par nahi.
CAC ko ek mahine ki fee se compare karna, client ke poori life value se nahi.

agencymargin.what: Agency profit margin matlab delivery aur operating costs ke baad revenue ka kitna bachta hai, aur agencies revenue ko profit samajhne ke liye mashhoor hain. ₹1 crore ki agency jiska kharch ₹95 lakh hai, woh ₹5 lakh ka business hai, ₹1 crore ka nahi. Do sabse bade leaks hain delivery cost - har client jo team ka waqt khaata hai - aur woh overhead jo agency ke saath chup-chaap badhta hai: zyada tools, badi office, zyada admin.
agencymargin.formula: Profit Margin % = (Revenue − Total Costs) ÷ Revenue × 100. ₹1,00,00,000 revenue, ₹95,00,000 costs: ₹5,00,000 bachta hai, 5% margin. Services agency ke liye 20% se 30% healthy hai aur 40% excellent. Sabse tez fix aksar price hota hai, cost nahi: same cost base par 10% price badhane se 5% margin 14.5% ho jaata hai, jitna tool-cutting se kabhi nahi hoga.
when: Saal review kar rahe ho aur jaanna hai agency ne actually kitna kamaya.
Agle saal ki pricing set kar rahe ho aur zaroori margin chahiye.
Ek mahine ko pichhle saal ke same mahine se compare kar rahe ho.
mistakes: Revenue ko profit kehna. Agency mein dono bahut alag hote hain.
Owner ki apni salary cost base se bahar chhod dena, jisse margin achha dikhta hai.
Tools aur software kaatna jab asli problem ye hai ki kaam ka price kam hai.

agencyroas.what: ROAS batata hai ki ad spend ke har rupee ne kitna revenue wapas laaya, aur yahi sabse tez tarika hai ye dekhne ka ki campaign khud ka kharcha nikal raha hai ya nahi. Rs 1,00,000 ads par lagaye aur Rs 4,00,000 revenue aaya to ROAS 4x hai. Yahan log galti karte hain 4x ko profit samajh kar: ROAS revenue leta hai, margin nahi, to 20% margin wale product par 4x ROAS char rupaye ka profit nahi, assi paise ka hai. Ye calculator ad revenue ko ad spend se divide karke multiple deta hai.
agencyroas.formula: ROAS = ad revenue / ad spend, 3x jaise multiple me. 1,00,000 lagaye aur 4,00,000 revenue aaya to ROAS = 4,00,000 / 1,00,000 = 4x. Tool bas yahi multiple deta hai, jaan-boojh kar: revenue wo number hai jo saaf measure hota hai. ROAS ko break-even test banane ke liye 1 ko apne contribution margin se divide karo - 25% margin par break-even ROAS = 1 / 0.25 = 4x, to 4x se neeche sab kuch paisa khota hai, chahe munaafa lage.
when: Jab do ad channels compare kar rahe ho aur dono ko ek hi scale par dekhna hai.
Jab campaign chal rahi ho aur jaanna hai ki kam se kam break-even ke liye kitna spend chahiye.
Jab launch se pehle target ROAS set kar rahe ho aur usko apne asli margin par tikaana chahte ho.
mistakes: ROAS ko profit padhna. Ye revenue / spend hai, to patle margin wale product par 4x ROAS bhi nuksaan de sakta hai.
Alag margin wale products ka ROAS aapas me compare karna. Break-even ROAS = 1 / margin, to 20% margin ko 5x chahiye aur 50% ko 2x.
Ad spend ke bahar ki costs chhod dena - returns, shipping, marketplace fees, payment-gateway charges.

aov.what: Average Order Value batati hai ki customer ek order me aam taur pe kitna kharch karta hai. Ek hi period ki total revenue ko orders ki ginti se divide karo. ₹1,00,000 ke 200 orders pe AOV ₹500 hai. Ye simple average lagta hai, par do cheezein chalata hai: customer jeetne pe kitna kharch kar sakte ho, aur ek chhota nudge - bundle, free-shipping threshold, upsell - kitne ka hai. AOV badhaana bina ek rupya extra ads pe kharch kiye profit badhata hai, isliye D2C brand ke liye ye sabse sasta lever hai.
aov.formula: AOV = Total Revenue ÷ Total Orders. Dono numbers ek hi period ke lo: ₹1,00,000 revenue 200 orders se matlab ₹500 per order. Mahine-dar-mahine compare karo, kyunki badhta AOV batata hai bundles aur upsells kaam kar rahe hain, aur girta AOV batata hai discounts basket kha rahe hain.
when: Free-shipping ya bundle threshold set kar rahe ho aur baseline chahiye.
Upsell ya cross-sell ne basket hilaya ya nahi, ye naap rahe ho.
Channels ke AOV compare kar rahe ho, spend decide karne se pehle.
mistakes: Periods mix karna - pichle mahine ki revenue is mahine ke orders pe.
Kuch bahut bade orders ko average ko skew karne dena, median check kiye bina.
AOV ko LTV samajh lena; ek order poori rishtedaari nahi hoti.

areabreakdown.what: Built-up area aur carpet area ka farq wahi chhupa hua gap hai jo Indian home buyers se lakhon le jaata hai. Builders built-up area batate hain kyunki woh bada number hai; jispar actually furniture rakh sakte ho woh carpet area hai. Farq ko loading kehte hain, aur flats mein ye aksar 20% se 30% hota hai. 1,200 sq ft built-up aur 25% loading wale flat ka carpet area 900 sq ft hai, aur aap jo per square foot actually de rahe ho woh brochure ke number se chauthai zyada hai.
areabreakdown.formula: Carpet Area = Built-up Area ÷ (1 + Loading %). 1,200 sq ft built-up, 25% loading: carpet area 1,200 ÷ 1.25 = 960 sq ft. Ulta karke asli rate dekho: ₹96 lakh ka flat 960 sq ft carpet par usable space ka ₹10,000 per sq ft hai, woh ₹8,000 nahi jo built-up figure dikhata hai. RERA carpet area disclose karna zaroori karta hai, isliye agreement ka number hi insist karo.
when: Do flats compare kar rahe ho aur ek built-up bol raha hai doosra carpet area.
Us space ka asli per-square-foot rate chahiye jo actually use kar sakte ho.
Check karna hai ki agreement brochure ke waade se match karta hai ya nahi.
mistakes: Built-up area ko carpet area se seedha compare karna. Dono ek measure nahi hain.
Loading sab jagah same maan lena. Builder, sheher aur project ke hisaab se badalta hai - 20% se kam se 35% se zyada.
Ye bhool jaana ki carpet area khud balcony aur bahari deewarein chhodta hai, isliye usable space aur bhi kam hoti hai.

ask.what: Ask Calculator wo sawaal ka jawab deta hai jo har founder pitch se pehle sochta hai: mujhe itna paisa chahiye, toh kitni equity lagegi? Jitna paisa chahiye aur jo valuation aap business ki maante ho, daaliye - kitna hissa dena padega, ye dikh jaata hai. ₹1.8 crore valuation pe ₹45 lakh maang rahe ho toh company ka chauthai hissa de rahe ho. Number saaf-saaf batata hai, aur yahi iska maksad hai - investor ke saamne khade hone se pehle founder ko sochna padta hai ki paisa hissa dene layak hai ya nahi.
ask.formula: Equity to Offer = Amount Needed ÷ Valuation × 100. ₹45 lakh chahiye aur valuation ₹1.8 crore hai toh ₹45,00,000 ÷ ₹1,80,00,000 × 100 = 25%. Valuation badhaao toh wahi paisa kam equity me aata hai; ghataao toh zyada hissa dena padta hai. Formula trade-off ko saaf kar deta hai, isliye ask andaaza nahi, decision ban jaata hai.
when: Pitch se pehle tay kar rahe ho ki kitna raise karna hai.
Bada cheque asli me kitni equity me padta hai, ye dekhna hai.
High price pe chhota round aur low price pe bada round, dono compare kar rahe ho.
mistakes: Pehle amount chunna aur valuation baad me, jisse plan se zyada hissa chala jaata hai.
Alag-alag deals ki equity compare karna bina unke peeche ki valuation dekhe.
Ye bhoolna ki ye sirf pehla round hai; aage ka har round isse aur dilute karta hai.

babyname.what: Baby name number calculator naam ke letters ko numerology ke letter-values se ek number mein badalta hai, aur dikhata hai ki woh number parampara mein kisse juda hai. Bahut Indian families naam chunte waqt ise dekhti hain, rashi aur nakshatra ke saath. Yeh parampara hai, science nahi, aur Tank Metrics ise wahi kehta hai - kai inputs mein se ek, rule nahi.
babyname.formula: Har letter ko Chaldean ya Pythagorean system mein 1 se 9 ka value milta hai, values jodi jaati hain, aur digits ghataakar 1 se 9 ka single digit banaya jaata hai - jab tak total 11, 22 ya 33 na ho, jinhe waise hi rakha jaata hai. 'Aarav' 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 6 = 11 banta hai, jo master number hai aur aage nahi ghatta.
when: Do naam spellings ke beech choose kar rahe ho aur unke numbers compare karne hain.
Jaanna hai ki koi naam kis number par aata hai.
Rashi aur nakshatra ke saath ek paramparik input chahiye.
mistakes: Number ko naam chunne ka sakht rule maan lena. Yeh parampara hai, requirement nahi.
Naam ki spelling badalne se alag jawab aata hai, aur ye na samajhna ki spelling ne number badla.
Sirf number ki wajah se rashi aur parivaar ki apni pasand ignore kar dena.

bmi.what: BMI calculator height aur weight se body mass index estimate karta hai, jo rough idea deta hai ki adult underweight, normal range, overweight ya obese hai. Yeh screening tool hai, diagnosis nahi: ye muscle aur fat mein farq nahi karta, aur bachchon, pregnant mahilaon ya bahut muscular logon ke liye banaya hi nahi gaya. India mein healthy range neeche hai, kyunki diabetes aur heart disease ka risk yahan Western populations se kam BMI par badhta hai.
bmi.formula: BMI = Weight kilogram mein ÷ (Height metres mein)². 70 kg aur 1.70 m: 70 ÷ (1.70 × 1.70) = 70 ÷ 2.89 = 24.2. WHO ranges: 18.5 se kam underweight, 18.5 se 24.9 normal, 25 se 29.9 overweight aur 30 se upar obese. Indians ke liye health authorities aksar 23 ko normal ki upper limit maante hain, isliye 24.2 BMI saavdhani hai, saaf bill of health nahi.
when: Quick general idea chahiye ki aapka weight aapki height ke liye kahaan hai.
Ek number ki jagah waqt ke saath badlav track kar rahe ho.
Indian-adjusted range jaanna hai, jo WHO se neeche hai.
mistakes: BMI ko diagnosis maan lena. Yeh screening estimate hai aur muscle, bone density aur body composition miss karta hai.
Indian adult ke liye WHO range use karna, jahan healthy ceiling neeche hai.
Ise bachchon ya pregnant mahilaon par lagana, jinke liye BMI sahi measure hi nahi hai.

breakeven.what: Break-even point woh exact sales volume hai jahan business paisa khona band karta hai aur kamane lagta hai. Isse neeche har sale aapko fixed costs se door rakhti hai; ispar rent, salary aur bills cover ho jaate hain; isse upar har extra unit contribute karta hai. Yeh pehla number hai jo lender ya investor actually maangta hai, kyunki ye batata hai ki business ki aaj ki sales aur nuksan ke beech kitni jagah hai.
breakeven.formula: Break-Even Units = Fixed Costs ÷ (Selling Price − Variable Cost). ₹2,00,000 mahina fixed cost, ₹500 mein bikne wala product jiska variable cost ₹300 hai, ₹200 contribution chhodta hai, toh break-even 1,000 units. Rupees mein 1,000 × ₹500 = ₹5,00,000 mahina revenue. Price badhao ya variable cost ghatao, break-even neeche aa jaata hai - yahi poora lever hai.
when: Monthly sales target set kar rahe ho aur floor chahiye, aspiration nahi.
Dukaan ya hiring jaisi fixed costs lene ka faisla kar rahe ho.
Lender ya investor ne poocha hai ki khona band karne ke liye kitna bechna padega.
mistakes: Kuch fixed costs chhod dena, jisse break-even asli se bahut kareeb lagta hai.
Gross revenue use karna contribution ki jagah - maayne rakhta hai har unit apni variable cost ke baad kitna chhodti hai.
Break-even ko profit target samajh lena. Break-even par kuch nahi kamate; wahan loss rukta hai.

breakevenad.what: Break-even ad spend matlab woh sabse zyada jo aap advertising par de sakte ho isse pehle ki campaign paisa kamana band kar de. Yeh ceiling hai, target nahi, aur ye aapke apne margin se set hoti hai - competitor kya bid kar rahe hain ya platform kya suggest karta hai, usse nahi. ₹300 contribution wala product sale jeetne ke liye usme se lagbhag poora kharch kar sakta hai aur phir bhi break even, par usse upar har rupee loss hai. Yeh number jaanna aapko bid karke loss mein jaane se rokta hai.
breakevenad.formula: Contribution per Sale = Revenue per Sale − Product Cost per Sale. Break-Even Ad Spend = Contribution per Sale × Expected Conversions. ₹1,000 mein becho, product cost ₹600, contribution ₹400. 20 conversions expect karte ho toh ₹8,000 tak kharch karke break even - ₹8,000 ad budget, ya maximum ₹400 cost per acquisition. ₹10,000 kharch karo toh campaign ₹2,000 khota hai.
when: Maximum bid ya daily ad budget set kar rahe ho.
Campaign chal rahi hai aur jaanna hai kab band karni hai.
Do products compare kar rahe ho aur dekhna hai kaunsa zyada ad spend jhel sakta hai.
mistakes: Contribution ki jagah revenue use karna. Ad spend afford karne se pehle product cost nikalni padti hai.
Break-even ko target samajh lena. Break-even par kuch nahi kamate; usse neeche kharch karna hai.
Delivery, packaging aur payment fees bhool jaana, jo contribution ghatate hain aur ceiling bhi.

brokerage.what: Brokerage calculator property agent ko dena wala commission nikalta hai, chahe sale par ya rental agreement par. India mein rate negotiable hai aur sheher aur property value ke hisaab se badalta hai - sale par aksar transaction value ka 1% se 2%, aur rental par ek mahine ka kiraya, landlord aur tenant ke beech baanta hua. ₹1.2 crore ke flat par 1% par brokerage ₹1.2 lakh hai, aur ye deal ke waqt dena padta hai, loan se nahi.
brokerage.formula: Brokerage = Transaction Amount × Commission Rate. ₹1.2 crore sale par 1% = ₹1,20,000. Rental mein brokerage aksar ek mahine ka kiraya hota hai, toh ₹35,000 mahina ka flat ₹35,000 ka, aksar landlord aur tenant mein barabar baanta hua. Bade deals par percentage neeche negotiate hota hai - ₹5 crore property par 2% matlab ₹10 lakh, aur zyadatar agents ispar baat karenge.
when: Kharid ya bech rahe ho aur maan lene se pehle commission jaanna hai.
Kiraye par le rahe ho aur agent ka maanga norm ke against check karna hai.
Do agents alag rates quote kar rahe hain - compare karna hai.
mistakes: Rate fix maan lena. India mein brokerage negotiable hai aur sheher ke hisaab se bahut badalta hai.
Ye bhool jaana ki brokerage home loan mein add nahi hoti - ye cash hai, deal par.
Dono taraf se dena bina agreement check kiye. Rental par standard kul ek mahine ka kiraya hai, har taraf se ek nahi.

burn.what: Burn rate batata hai business har mahine kitni tezi se cash kharch karta hai; runway batata hai ki paisa khatam hone me kitne mahine bache hain. ₹10,00,000 bank me aur ₹1,00,000 monthly burn pe das mahine. Dono numbers aane wale kal ka andaaza hain jise aap abhi badal sakte ho - yahi baat hai: jo founder March me runway jaanta hai wo March me cost kaat sakta hai, jo December me pata chalta hai wo nahi. Runway wo ek number hai jo tay karta hai plan chalane ke liye kitna time hai.
burn.formula: Runway (mahine) = Cash in Bank ÷ Net Monthly Burn. Net burn matlab monthly kharch minus monthly income - agar business kharch se zyada kama raha hai toh burn nahi hai aur runway unlimited hai. ₹10,00,000 ÷ ₹1,00,000 = 10 mahine. Har mahine dobara nikalo, kyunki cash aur burn dono badalte hain.
when: Fundraise kitne time me close karna hai, ye plan kar rahe ho.
Abhi hire karein ya rukein, ye tay kar rahe ho.
Investors ko report kar rahe ho aur cash position ek line me chahiye.
mistakes: Gross burn (kharch) use karna net burn (kharch minus income) ke bajaye, jisse runway kam dikta hai.
One-off costs - tax bill, bada renewal - bhool jaana jo runway window me aate hain.
Runway ko fixed maan lena; revenue ya spend badalte hi ye badal jaata hai, isliye har mahine nikalo.

cac.what: Customer Acquisition Cost wo rupee figure hai jo ek hi sawaal ka jawab deta hai: ek customer jeetne me kitna kharcha hua? Ek period me ads, sales team ki salary, agency fees aur discounts - sab jodo, aur us kharch se aaye naye customers ki ginti se divide karo; CAC mil jaata hai. Ye pehla number hai jo founder ko pata hona chahiye, kyunki isi se decide hota hai ki growth paisa banati hai ya jalati hai. ₹1,00,000 kharch karke 200 customers laaye, toh har customer ₹500 ka pada - sasta ya mehnga, ye sirf us customer ki value ke saamne tay hota hai.
cac.formula: CAC = Total Sales aur Marketing Kharch ÷ Naye Customers. Ek fixed period me customer jeetne ka poora kharch lo - ad spend, sales team, agency fees, entry discount - aur usi period ke naye customers se divide karo. ₹1,00,000 ka kharch 200 naye customers laata hai toh CAC ₹500 hai. Salary ya discount chhod diya toh number accha dikhta hai par asli cost chhupi rehti hai.
when: Ad spend badhane se pehle, per-customer cost jaanne ke liye.
Investor growth ki efficiency poochta hai, aur ek number se jawab dena hai.
Do channels compare kar rahe ho - sasta dikhne wala high-CAC channel aksar low-CAC se haar jaata hai.
mistakes: Sirf ad spend ginna aur sales salary, agency fees, tooling chhod dena, jisse CAC asli se kaafi kam dikhta hai.
Is mahine ka kharch pichle mahine ke customers se divide karna - do periods mix ho jaate hain.
CAC ko revenue se compare karna, gross profit se nahi - customer ka kharch profit se wapas aata hai, turnover se nahi.

cagr.what: CAGR woh ek steady saalana rate hai jo business ko shuru se jahaan pahuncha wahan le jaata, chahe safar kitna bhi utaar-chadhav wala raha ho. Growth batane ka yeh sabse insaaf wala tareeka hai kyunki isse farq nahi padta ki growth barabar aayi ya ek achhe saal mein. ₹1 crore se ₹2.5 crore chaar saal mein pahuncha business takreeban 25.7% saalana badha hai, chahe usne saal ek mein kuch na kiya ho aur saal chaar mein dugna ho gaya ho. Investors CAGR maangte hain kyunki ye do businesses ko comparable banata hai.
cagr.formula: CAGR = (Ending Value ÷ Starting Value)^(1 ÷ Years) − 1. ₹1 crore se ₹2.5 crore 4 saal mein: (2.5)^(1/4) − 1 = 25.7% saalana. Wahi ₹1 crore se ₹2.5 crore 2 saal mein 58.1% saalana - natija ek, business bilkul alag. Isliye bina time period wala CAGR bekaar hai.
when: Investor ko growth report kar rahe ho aur ek imaandar saalana number chahiye.
Apni growth competitor ki growth se alag periods par compare kar rahe ho.
Check karna hai ki projected growth rate aapke business stage ke liye realistic hai ya nahi.
mistakes: CAGR ki jagah simple average growth use karna. Achhe aur bure saal ka average aisa number deta hai jo kabhi hua hi nahi.
Bahut chhote period ka CAGR batana. Do saal ki high growth business ke baare mein kuch nahi batati.
Jo number bahut upar-neeche gaya uspar CAGR lagana. Yeh path smooth kar deta hai, jisse ek exceptional saal wale business ki tareef zyada ho jaati hai.

captable.what: Cap table wo chalti hui list hai jisme likha hota hai kiska kitna hissa hai: founders, investors, aur employees ka option pool. Ye tool ESOP pool aur investor stake lekar dikhata hai ki founders ke paas kya bachta hai. 18% option pool aur 18% investors ke liye chhod do toh founders ke paas 64% rehta hai. Cap table wahi jagah hai jahan dilution feeling se number ban jaati hai, aur ye pehla document hai jo serious investor maangta hai - gadbad table se lagta hai founder ne kaam nahi kiya.
captable.formula: Founders' Share = 100% − ESOP Pool − Investor Equity (aur koi bhi reserved hissa). 100% − 18% − 18% = 64%. Cap table ki har row ek hi whole ka percentage hai, isliye rows ka jod 100 hona chahiye; agar nahi hai toh kuch double-count ya missing hai.
when: Fundraise ke liye data room taiyaar kar rahe ho.
Senior hiring se pehle ESOP pool ka size tay kar rahe ho.
Term sheet ko apni current table se check karna hai.
mistakes: ESOP pool round ke baad set karna, pehle nahi - founders planned se zyada dilute ho jaate hain.
Convertible notes ya SAFEs chhod dena, jo baad me convert hokar table ko achanak dilute kar dete hain.
Percentages ka jod 100 na hona, jisse koi missing holder chhup jaata hai.

ccc.what: Cash conversion cycle batata hai ki stock ke liye paisa dene se lekar customers se paisa aane tak aapka paisa business mein kitne din phasa rehta hai. Business kagaz par profitable ho sakta hai aur phir bhi cash khatam ho sakta hai - aur aksar yahi wajah hoti hai. Aap inventory kharidte ho, rakhte ho, credit par bechte ho, aur tab jaakar collect karte ho. Us chain ka har din aapke paise ka din hai jo kisi aur ke liye kaam kar raha hai. Cycle ghataana aksar sales badhane se tez hota hai.
ccc.formula: CCC = Days Inventory + Days Receivables − Days Payables. Stock 60 din padha, customers 45 din mein pay karte hain, aur aap suppliers ko 30 din mein dete ho, toh cycle 60 + 45 − 30 = 75 din. Matlab 75 din ki cost kahin se fund karni padegi - aksar apni jeb se ya loan se. Supplier terms 30 ki jagah 45 kar do toh cycle 60 din ho jaata hai, bina ek rupee extra sales ke.
when: Profitable ho par hamesha cash ki kami rahe, aur dekhna hai paisa kahaan phasa hai.
Supplier ya bade customer ke saath payment terms negotiate kar rahe ho.
Busy season se pehle kitna working capital chahiye ye plan kar rahe ho.
mistakes: Cycle best customer par measure karna, average par nahi. Ek slow payer poora number kheench leta hai.
Ratio sudharne ke liye payables badhana bina ye dekhe ki suppliers phir price badha dete hain ya supply band kar dete hain.
Profit ko cash samajh lena. 90-din cycle wala profitable business bhi doob sakta hai.

churn.what: Churn rate matlab ek period mein kitne percent clients ya customers jaate hain, aur yahi number chup-chaap tay karta hai ki business badhega ya wahin khada rahega. Har mahine 5% clients khona serious nahi lagta jab tak ye samajh na aaye ki saal mein lagbhag aadhe chale jaate hain. Churn growth par cap bhi lagata hai: agar har mahine 8 clients jaate hain aur 8 aate hain, toh aap wahin rehne ke liye mehnat kar rahe ho.
churn.formula: Churn Rate % = Clients Lost ÷ Clients at Start × 100. 120 mein se 6 clients khona = 5% monthly churn. Saalana, takreeban 46% base saal mein chala jaata hai. Har mahine 10 clients badhne ke liye 16 jeetne padenge, kyunki 6 jaa rahe hain. Churn 5% se 3% karna aksar naye sales dugna karne se zyada kaam ka hota hai, aur sasta bhi, kyunki clients pehle se aapke hain.
when: Client retention review kar rahe ho aur imaandar monthly figure chahiye.
Sales target set kar rahe ho aur jaanna hai churn usme se kitna khaayega.
Faisla karna hai ki retention mein invest karna hai ya acquisition mein.
mistakes: Churn saalana measure karna aur ye miss karna ki monthly figure compound hota hai.
Client ko retained ginna sirf isliye ki contract hai, chahe usne service use karna band kar diya ho.
Revenue churn batana jab sawaal customer churn ka tha - ek bada client jaane se dono bahut alag hilti hain.

clientltv.what: Client lifetime value matlab ek client jaane se pehle kul kitna revenue deta hai, aur agency ke liye yahi number tay karta hai ki usse paane ke liye kitna kharch kar sakte ho. ₹40,000 mahina dene wala client jo 18 mahine rukta hai, woh ₹7.2 lakh ka hai - ₹40,000 ka nahi. Jo agencies har client ko ek mahine ki fee jitna maan kar price, hiring aur advertising karti hain, woh hamesha cash-starved rehti hain, kyunki woh rishte ko one-off samajh rahi hain jabki woh dedh saal ki annuity hai.
clientltv.formula: LTV = Monthly Revenue × Average Lifetime in months. ₹40,000 mahina, 18 mahine = ₹7.2 lakh. Zyada sahi figure ke liye revenue ki jagah gross margin lo: 60% margin par wahi client ₹4.32 lakh ka actual profit hai. Asli ratio LTV aur client paane ki cost ke beech hai - healthy agency LTV ko CAC ka teen guna ya zyada rakhti hai.
when: Retainer price set kar rahe ho aur rishte ki asli value jaanna chahte ho.
Ek lead ya outbound campaign ke liye kitna de sakte ho ye decide karna hai.
Do client types compare kar rahe ho aur dekhna hai saal mein kaunsa zyada deta hai, mahine mein nahi.
mistakes: Revenue ko value kehna. Margin woh hai jo aap rakhte ho, aur zyada revenue wala client jiska delivery cost bhaari ho, sabse kam value wala nikal sakta hai.
Average lifetime guess karna, measure karna nahi. Zyadatar agencies ka anumaan kaafi zyada hota hai.
Churn ignore karna. Agar saal mein chauthai clients jaate hain, average lifetime chaar saal hai, hamesha nahi.

clientprofit.what: Client profitability woh sawaal hai jo agency owner bahut der se poochta hai: team, tools aur overhead nikalne ke baad, is client ne mujhe paisa banaya ya nahi? ₹2 lakh mahina ka retainer achha client lagta hai - jab tak us par lage teen log, ad tools, aur rent-admin ka hissa na gin lo. Bahut agencies ko pata chalta hai ki unka sabse bada client sabse patla margin hai, aur sabse chhota chup-chaap sabse profitable. Yeh calculator fee ke saath delivery cost aur overhead rakhta hai.
clientprofit.formula: Client Profit = Fee − Delivery Cost − Allocated Overhead. Margin % = (Profit ÷ Fee) × 100. ₹2,00,000 fee, ₹1,30,000 delivery cost aur ₹30,000 allocated overhead par ₹40,000 bachta hai - 20% margin. Agencies ke liye 40% se 60% healthy hai, 20% kamzor, aur 15% se neeche client aksar ek late payment door loss se hota hai. Maksad clients ko nikaalna nahi, jinki price badhani hai unhe dhoondhna hai.
when: Client list review kar rahe ho aur dekhna hai kaunsa rishta actually paisa deta hai.
Retainer renew karne wale ho aur price tay karne se pehle numbers chahiye.
Naya client unke diye price par lena hai ya nahi ye decide karna hai.
mistakes: Overhead chhod dena. Rent, software aur admin asli costs hain aur har client unme hissa rakhta hai.
Sirf woh ghante ginna jo dikhte hain. Agency owner ka apna waqt bhi cost hai, chahe timesheet par na ho.
Low-margin client ko price badhane se pehle nikaal dena. Aksar fix zyada fee hoti hai, khoya client nahi.

cm.what: Contribution margin batata hai ki har sale se variable cost nikalne ke baad kya bachta hai, aur yahi number batata hai ki product business ka kharcha utha sakta hai ya nahi. Rs 500 me becho aur variable cost Rs 300 ho to contribution Rs 200, yaani 40% margin. Yahi Rs 200 rent, salary, ads aur baaki fixed costs cover karta hai; fixed costs cover hone ke baad hi profit banta hai. Ye calculator selling price aur variable cost se per-unit contribution aur percentage deta hai.
cm.formula: Contribution margin per unit = selling price - variable cost per unit. Percentage me: (selling price - variable cost) / selling price x 100. Price 500 aur variable cost 300 par contribution 500 - 300 = 200, jo 200 / 500 x 100 = 40% hai. Fixed costs is calculation me nahi aate; wo wahi hain jinko contribution cover karta hai, aur break-even = fixed costs / per-unit contribution.
when: Jab decide kar rahe ho ki product bechna worth hai ya nahi, fixed costs dekhne se pehle.
Jab discount set kar rahe ho aur jaanna hai ki price kitna gir sakta hai contribution khatam hone se pehle.
Jab do products me se ek push karna hai aur revenue par nahi, har sale ke contribution par compare karna hai.
mistakes: Fixed costs ko variable cost me mila dena. Rent aur salary fixed hain; sirf material, packaging aur per-order fees variable hain.
Contribution margin ko net margin samajhna. Contribution fixed costs ignore karta hai, isliye hamesha bada number hota hai.
Discount contribution percentage par dena, price par nahi. 40% contribution margin par 20% price cut aadha contribution kha jaata hai, panchva hissa nahi.

codrto.what: COD & RTO Loss Calculator cash-on-delivery ke un orders ka nuksaan rupaye me dikhata hai jo wapas aa jaate hain. RTO — return to origin — wo parcel hai jise courier customer tak le gaya, deliver nahi kar paya aur wapas aapke paas le aaya; forward freight, return freight aur aksar packaging aap bharte ho, aur sale hui hi nahi. Tool aapke COD volume aur RTO rate se nikaalta hai ki kitne parcel bounce hue aur unse mahine me kitna paisa gaya. Ye tab kholo jab category kagaz par profitable lagti hai par bank balance mana kar deta hai.
codrto.formula: RTO orders = total COD orders x RTO rate / 100. Total loss = RTO orders x loss per RTO order. Loss per RTO order matlab ek bounce ki poori cost — forward freight plus return freight plus packaging plus re-attempt charge — sirf wahi courier bill nahi jo pehle dikhta hai. Tool dono ko multiply karta hai taki volume ke saath loss kitna badhta hai ye dikhe.
when: Jab aapka COD share zyada ho aur cut karne se pehle jaanna ho ki returns kitna kha rahe hain.
Jab aap soch rahe ho ki prepaid discount de kar customers ko COD se hataana chahiye ya nahi.
Jab aap freight rate negotiate kar rahe ho aur courier ko dikhana ho ki RTO aapko kitna mehnga pad raha hai.
mistakes: Sirf return freight ginna aur forward leg bhool jaana, jo aap har haal me bharte ho.
RTO ko saare orders ka percent maanna, sirf COD orders ka nahi, jisse aankda kam dikhta hai.
Ye na dekhna ki wapas aaya parcel ek doosri sale bhi maarta hai, kyunki stock ek hafte market se bahar rehta hai.

cofounder.what: Co-founder equity split wo sabse mushkil baat ka jawab deta hai: kisko kitna milega. Sabse insaaf wala tareeka har founder ko uske diye gaye cheezon pe score karna hai - idea, paisa, time, skills, network, risk - aur equity usi hisaab se baantna. Har founder ka score daaliye, percentage mil jaata hai. Barabar 12-12-12 se saaf teen-way split hota hai, par asli splits aksar barabar nahi hote, aur abhi numbers me kaaran likh dena aage jhagde se bachaata hai jab company ki value badh jaaye.
cofounder.formula: Founder Share % = Founder Score ÷ Total of All Scores × 100. Teen founders 12, 12, 12 pe 33.3% rakhte hain; 20, 15, 10 pe 44.4%, 33.3%, 22.2%. Har banda kya de raha hai - paisa, full-time time, idea, skills - usko score karo, taaki split mehnat dikhaye, ye nahi ki pehle kaun bola.
when: Co-founders ke saath pehli baar cap table set kar rahe ho.
Naya co-founder aata hai aur purana split dobara karna hai.
Investor poochta hai ki founding equity aise kyun baanti gayi.
mistakes: Jhagde se bachne ke liye barabar baant dena, phir jab ek founder zyada kaam kare toh chidh hona.
Idea ko sabse bada hissa dena aur jo business chalaayega usko chhota hissa.
Split ko chat me chhod dena, vesting ke saath signed agreement ke bajaye.

compatibility.what: Compatibility calculator do naamon ko ek playful scoring formula se compare karta hai aur percentage deta hai. Yeh love calculator jaisa hi idea hai, bas method alag - letters match hote hain, gine jaate hain aur ek score mein ghata diye jaate hain. Iske peeche koi claim nahi hai aur koi evidence nahi hai. Yeh fun tool hai, aur site ise insight batane ki jagah saaf-saaf yahi kehti hai.
compatibility.formula: Dono naam letter-dar-letter match hote hain, common letters gine aur weight kiye jaate hain, aur total 100 mein se percentage bana diya jaata hai. Wahi jodi hamesha wahi result deti hai, aur yahi iski ekmaatra predictable baat hai. Zyada score kam score se zyada matlab nahi rakhta - dono letters par arithmetic hain.
when: Quick, playful jawab share karna hai.
Jaanna hai do naam ek doosre ke against kitna score karte hain.
Assessment nahi, halka-phulka tool chahiye.
mistakes: Score ko logon ke beech asli compatibility ka measure padhna.
Isse rishte ke baare mein koi nateeja nikaalna.
Ye maanna ki alag spelling se jawab nahi badlega - badlega.

compint.what: Compound Interest batata hai ki koi amount kitna badhta hai jab byaaj wapas principal me jud jaata hai aur khud byaaj kamata hai. ₹10,000, 8% par paanch saal me ₹14,000 nahi hota; usse zyada hota hai, kyunki har saal ka byaaj balance me jud jaata hai. Tool ye bhi leta hai ki saal me kitni baar byaaj judta hai, aur yahi baat log miss karte hain: wahi rate mahine-mahine dene par saal me ek baar dene se zyada par pahunchta hai.
compint.formula: Total = Principal × (1 + Rate ÷ Times ÷ 100) ^ (Times × Years). Rate saalana percentage hai, Times batata hai saal me kitni baar byaaj judta hai (1, 4 ya 12), aur Years term hai. Tool total se principal ghata kar sirf interest dikhata hai. Same headline rate par Times badhane se total badhta hai.
when: Jab aap quarterly compound hone wali FD ko monthly compound hone wali FD se compare kar rahe ho.
Jab aap project kar rahe ho ki monthly SIP ya lump sum kuch saalon me kitna banega.
Jab aap dekhna chahte ho ki lambe loan ki kul cost me kitna hissa byaaj hai, principal nahi.
mistakes: Multi-year figure ke liye simple interest lagana. Bank compound karte hain, isliye simple interest ka jawab hamesha kam dikhata hai ki aap kitna denge ya kamayenge.
Ye bhoolna ki byaaj kitni baar judta hai. 8% mahine-mahine dene ka matlab 8% saal me ek baar dene se alag hai, aur term badhne par gap badhta hai.
Ye bhoolna ki rate saalana hai. Yearly field me monthly rate daalne se jawab barah guna ho jaata hai.

cpcpa.what: CPC to CPA converter us price ko badalta hai jo aap click ke liye dete ho us price mein jo customer actually paane ke liye dete ho. CPC ek visit ka price hai; CPA ek result ka price. Dono ke beech ka pul aapka conversion rate hai, aur aksar sudharne ka sabse sasta tareeka yahi hota hai. ₹10 CPC aur 2% conversion par customer ₹500 ka padta hai. Conversion 4% kar do toh wahi customer ₹250 ka - ad, audience ya bid badle bina.
cpcpa.formula: CPA = CPC ÷ Conversion Rate. ₹10 per click 2% par ₹500 per acquisition. Wahi ₹10 5% par ₹200. Ulta karke target set karo: agar 3% conversion par ₹300 tak afford kar sakte ho, toh ₹9 per click tak bid kar sakte ho. Yahi ek division bid tay karti hai, guess nahi.
when: CPC aur conversion rate pata hai aur customer ki asli cost nikaalni hai.
Jo CPA afford kar sakte ho usse maximum bid set karni hai.
Zyaada traffic par kharch karna hai ya landing page convert karana hai - ye decide karna hai.
mistakes: CPC ko customer ki cost maan lena. Yeh ek visit ki cost hai, aur zyadatar visits kharidti nahi.
Ad sudharna jab landing page sale gawa raha ho. Leverage aksar conversion rate mein hota hai.
Blended conversion rate use karna jab mobile aur desktop bilkul alag behave karte hain.

cpmcpc.what: CPM to CPC converter us price ko badalta hai jo aapne hazar impressions ke liye diya, us price mein jo aapne actually ek click ke liye diya. CPM ad platforms inventory bechne ka tareeka hai - hazar views ka price. CPC woh hai jo asli log click karne par padta hai. Dono ke beech ka gap aapka click-through rate hai, aur yahi ek number campaign ko sasta ya mehnga banata hai. Do campaigns dono ₹200 CPM par quote ho sakte hain par CPC bilkul alag de sakte hain, kyunki ek creative click hoti hai aur doosri nahi.
cpmcpc.formula: CPC = (CPM ÷ 1000) × Impressions ÷ Clicks, ya seedha CPM ÷ (CTR% × 10). ₹200 CPM par 50,000 impressions aur 1,000 clicks: spend ₹10,000, toh CPC ₹10. CTR 4% kar do toh CPM badle bina CPC aadha ho jaata hai, ₹5. Isliye behtar creative aksar bade budget se zyada kaam ka hota hai - ye har click ka price kam kar deti hai.
when: Platform CPM quote kar raha hai aur budget dene se pehle asli cost per click jaanna hai.
Do channels CPM par same lag rahe hain aur CPC par compare karna hai.
Target CPC set kar rahe ho aur uske liye zaroori click-through rate nikaalna hai.
mistakes: CPM ko final cost maan lena. Yeh entry price hai, outcome nahi.
Kam CPC ko achha maan lena bina clicks ki quality dekhe. Jo sasta click kabhi convert nahi hota, wahi sabse mehnga hai.
CPM ko per thousand impressions ki jagah per impression maan lena - isse arithmetic 1,000 guna bigad jaata hai.

ctc.what: CTC calculator dikhata hai ki ek employee par company ka actually kitna kharch hota hai, jo offer letter ki salary se hamesha zyada hota hai. Gross salary ke upar employer provident fund deta hai, aur aksar gratuity, insurance aur doosre benefits bhi. Chhote business owner ke liye yahi number budget karna hai, kyunki ₹50,000 mahina par hiring ₹50,000 mahina se kaafi zyada padti hai. Employee ke liye ye samjhata hai ki take-home CTC se kam kyun hota hai.
ctc.formula: Employer Cost = Gross Monthly Salary + Employer PF + Other Monthly Benefits, aur saalana figure uska barah guna. ₹50,000 gross salary, 12% employer PF ₹6,000 aur ₹2,000 doosre benefits: mahina ₹58,000, saalana ₹6,96,000. Basic ka takreeban 4.81% gratuity jodo toh asli saalana cost ₹7 lakh cross kar jaati hai - jabki CTC ₹6 lakh lag rahi thi.
when: Hiring kar rahe ho aur budget ke liye asli monthly cost chahiye.
Employee ho aur check karna hai ki take-home CTC se itna kam kyun hai.
Full-time hire ko freelancer se compare kar rahe ho.
mistakes: Sirf gross salary budget karna aur PF aur benefits ki cost par chaunk jaana.
CTC ko take-home samajh lena. CTC mein employer contributions hote hain jo employee ke bank account tak nahi pahunchte.
Gratuity bhool jaana, jo har saal jama hoti hai aur service ke ant mein deni padti hai.

daysbetween.what: Days between two dates do dates ke beech calendar din ginta hai, jo trivial lagta hai jab tak iski zaroorat na pade. Iska use notice period, invoice due dates, interest accrual, project timelines aur deadline se pehle bache din nikaalne mein hota hai. Yeh calendar din ginta hai, working days nahi, isliye 30-din ka notice period weekends aur holidays bhi cover karta hai - aur isliye 'ek mahine' ka notice aksar 30 din se zyada hota hai.
daysbetween.formula: Days = End Date − Start Date, calendar din mein. 1 April se 30 April 29 din hai, 30 nahi, kyunki start date nahi ginti. 15 January se 15 March, non-leap saal mein, 59 din hai. Due date ke liye invoice date par credit period jodo: 1 March ke invoice par 45-din term 15 April ko due hota hai.
when: Notice period ya contract deadline check kar rahe ho.
Nikaal rahe ho ki invoice actually kab due hota hai.
Project timeline plan kar rahe ho aur dinon ki ginti chahiye.
mistakes: Start date ko din ek ginna, jisse har jawab mein ek din badh jaata hai.
Calendar din aur working days confuse karna. Sirf pehla weekends aur holidays ginnta hai.
Ye bhool jaana ki February leap year mein badalta hai, jisse uske baad ki har date khisak jaati hai.

debteq.what: Debt-plus-equity deal me investor ka paisa do hisson me bant jaata hai: ek loan jo business ko chukana hai, aur equity jo pakka hissa kharidti hai. Shark Tank India me ye aam hai kyunki isse shark kam ownership lete hue bhi paisa wapas paata hai. Total deal, debt portion aur equity wali valuation daaliye - loan amount, equity amount aur stake dikh jaata hai. Debt cash flow se chukta hai, chahe business badhe ya na badhe; equity kabhi wapas nahi hoti.
debteq.formula: Debt Amount = Total Deal × Debt Portion %; Equity Amount = Total Deal − Debt Amount; Equity % = Equity Amount ÷ Valuation × 100. ₹4.5 crore ke deal me 18% debt ho toh ₹81 lakh loan hai aur baaki equity. Debt pakki obligation hai, equity pakka claim - dono ko mila dena chhupa deta hai ki asli mehnga kaun hai.
when: Term sheet me loan aur equity mila hua hai aur dono alag dekhne hain.
Tay kar rahe ho ki deal ka kitna hissa repayable debt lena hai, permanent equity nahi.
Pure-equity offer aur debt-wale offer ko compare kar rahe ho.
mistakes: Poore deal ko equity maan lena aur dilution kam ginna.
Debt portion bhool jaana, jo cash flow se chukta hai aur working capital dabata hai.
Sirf stake dekhkar deal judge karna jabki debt hi tay karta hai business saans le sakta hai ya nahi.

depreciation.what: Straight-line depreciation asset ki cost ko un saalon mein barabar baant deta hai jinme aap use karne wale ho. ₹10 lakh ki machine jo das saal chalegi, business ko har saal ₹1 lakh ki padti hai, chahe us saal kuch kharch na kiya ho. Yeh cash payment nahi hai - yeh accounting ka tareeka hai asset ki cost ko un saalon se match karne ka jo usse faayda uthate hain, aur yahi profit figure ko imaandar banata hai.
depreciation.formula: Yearly Depreciation = (Asset Cost − Salvage Value) ÷ Useful Life. ₹10,00,000 ki machine, ₹1,00,000 resale value, 10 saal: (10,00,000 − 1,00,000) ÷ 10 = ₹90,000 saalana. Chaar saal baad book value ₹10,00,000 − ₹3,60,000 = ₹6,40,000. Tax ke liye Income Tax Act written-down value blocks use karta hai, isliye accounting figure aur tax figure alag hote hain - accountant dono reconcile karta hai.
when: Accounts taiyaar kar rahe ho aur asset ka saalana charge chahiye.
Equipment kharidna hai ya kiraye par lena hai - asli saalana cost maayne rakhti hai.
Jaanna hai ki asset books par abhi kitne ka hai.
mistakes: Depreciation ko business se jaata cash samajh lena. Yeh non-cash charge hai aur paisa asset kharidte waqt gaya tha.
Useful life bahut lambi rakhna taaki profit achha dikhe - phir asset likhne se pehle toot jaata hai.
Ye bhool jaana ki tax depreciation Income Tax Act ke rates par chalti hai, aapke anumaan par nahi.

dilution.what: Dilution matlab deal me founder ka kitna hissa chala jaata hai, aur kitna bachta hai. Aaj 100% aapka hai aur investor ko 10% diya toh 90% aapke paas - par asli baat ye hai ki wo 10% kya khareedta hai. Dilution compound karti hai: 10% round, phir 20% round, phir ESOP pool - aur 100% se shuru karne wala founder aadhe se neeche pahunch sakta hai. Ye calculator ek round ke baad ki ownership dikhata hai, taaki deal ki keemat sign se pehle dikhe, baad me nahi.
dilution.formula: Founder Equity After = Founder Equity Before − Equity Offered. 100% − 10% = 90%. Kai rounds me percentages ghatane ke bajaye fractions multiply karo: pehle round ke baad 90%, phir 20% aur gaya toh 72% bachta hai, 70% nahi. Yahi multiplication founders ko chaunkata hai - har round chhoti base pe lagta hai.
when: Term sheet aaya hai aur stake ke baad apni ownership dekhni hai.
Do rounds plan kar rahe ho aur pata karna hai kahan pahunchoge.
ESOP pool set kar rahe ho aur founders pe uska asar dekhna hai.
mistakes: Rounds ke beech percentages ghatana, fractions multiply karne ke bajaye - isse nuksaan kam dikhta hai.
ESOP pool bhool jaana, jo founders ko bilkul investor ki tarah dilute karta hai.
Sirf stake dekhna valuation ke bina - high price pe 20% dena, low price pe 5% se kam pad sakta hai.

discountimpact.what: Discount impact calculator dikhata hai ki discount aapko actually kitna padta hai, aur yeh percentage se kaafi zyada hota hai. 40% margin wale product par 10% discount aapke profit ka 10% nahi khaata - chauthai kha jaata hai. Yahi number founders miss karte hain jab woh deal close karne ke liye 'chhota' discount dete hain, kyunki discount price se jaata hai par cost bilkul wahin rehti hai.
discountimpact.formula: New Price = Selling Price × (1 − Discount %). New Profit = New Price − Cost Price. ₹1,000 mein bikne wala product jiski cost ₹600 hai, ₹400 profit deta hai. 10% discount se price ₹900, toh profit ₹300 - 10% discount par profit mein 25% ki giri. Khooye profit ko wapas kamane ke liye 33% zyada volume chahiye, isliye blanket discounts itne kam kaam ke hote hain.
when: Customer discount maang raha hai aur asli cost jaanna hai.
Sale chala rahe ho aur break-even ke liye zaroori volume nikaalna hai.
Discount ko sale jeetne ke doosre tareekon se compare kar rahe ho.
mistakes: Discount ko profit ke percentage ki tarah padhna. Yeh price se jaata hai, aur profit bahut chhota number hota hai.
Discount dene se pehle ye nikaalna nahi ki usse justify karne ke liye kitna extra volume chahiye.
Kam margin wale product par discount dena, jahan wahi percentage lagbhag poora profit kha jaata hai.

distmargin.what: Distributor aur retailer margin calculator dikhata hai ki aap jis price par bechte ho aur customer jo deta hai, unke beech ka farq chain mein kaise bantta hai. India mein physical product aksar manufacturer se distributor se retailer se customer tak jaata hai, aur har stage ko itna margin chahiye ki product shelf par rahe. Agar MRP har stage check kiye bina set kiya, product push hi nahi hota - distributors aur retailers chup-chaap woh brand prefer karte hain jo zyada deta hai. Yeh calculator har step ka margin dikhata hai.
distmargin.formula: Distributor Margin % = (MRP − Distributor Price) ÷ MRP × 100, aur Retailer Margin % = (Distributor Price − Manufacturer Price) ÷ Distributor Price × 100, jis stage ko measure kar rahe ho uske hisaab se. India mein typical range: distributor 8% se 12%, retailer 15% se 25%. Agar product banane mein ₹60 lagte hain aur MRP ₹100 hai, toh baantne ke liye ₹40 hain. Distributor ko 10% aur retailer ko 20% do toh aapke paas ₹30 bachta hai - aur wahi aapka asli margin hai.
when: Physical product launch kar rahe ho aur aisa MRP set karna hai jisme sabka margin bache.
Distributor keh raha hai margins patle hain aur check karna hai woh sahi hai ya nahi.
Direct online bechna hai ya trade ke through jaana hai - compare karna hai.
mistakes: Apni cost se MRP set karna bina trade ke liye jagah chhode, phir hairan hona ki koi stock nahi karta.
Margin galat base par nikaalna - distributor margin aksar MRP par, retailer margin us price par jis par woh kharidta hai.
Ye bhool jaana ki GST iske upar baithta hai aur kisi ke margin ka hissa nahi hai.

downpayment.what: Down payment calculator woh cash batata hai jo home loan shuru hone se pehle jodna padta hai, aur yahi number zyadatar first-time buyers ko rok deta hai. India mein banks aksar property value ka 75% se 90% tak lend karte hain, toh bache hue 10% se 25% apni jeb se aane chahiye. ₹80 lakh ke flat par 80% loan-to-value par down payment ₹16 lakh hai - aur ye stamp duty aur registration se pehle, jo loan mein add hi nahi hoti.
downpayment.formula: Down Payment = Property Price × (1 − Loan-to-Value %). ₹80 lakh flat, 80% LTV: ₹16 lakh down aur ₹64 lakh loan. Pehle din jo cash actually chahiye woh zyada hai: stamp duty aur registration jodo, aksar 6% se 8%, matlab takreeban ₹5 lakh zyada - kul ₹21 lakh. Lenders LTV agreement value aur valuation report mein se jo kam ho uspar set karte hain, isliye zyada quoted price hamesha loan nahi badhata.
when: Property chun li hai aur apply karne se pehle jod-ne wala cash jaanna hai.
Do flats compare kar rahe ho aur ek mein bahut zyada upfront chahiye.
Kharidne se pehle kitna bachana padega ye nikaalna hai.
mistakes: Sirf down payment ka budget rakhna aur stamp duty aur registration bhool jaana, jo typical flat par kai lakh jodte hain.
Maanna ki bank poora property price fund karegi. LTV cap valuation par hai, asking price par nahi.
Down payment ke liye poori savings khaali kar dena aur registration, shifting costs ya emergency ke liye kuch na chhodna.

ebitda.what:
EBITDA & Margin us sawaal ka jawab deta hai jo koi bhi investor sabse pehle poochta hai: business apne asli kaam se paisa banata hai ya nahi? Tool revenue leta hai, usme se cost of goods sold aur operating expenses hataata hai, aur jo bachta hai wo dikhata hai — earnings before interest, tax, depreciation aur amortisation — aur usko revenue ke percent me bhi. Rupee ka number batata hai core kaam kitna chhodta hai; margin batata hai wo kitni efficiency se hota hai.

Margin hi asli cheez hai. Do company ek hi ₹10 lakh ka EBITDA dikha sakti hain lekin haalat bilkul alag ho sakti hai: ₹50 lakh revenue par ₹10 lakh matlab 20% margin aur pricing power wala business, jabki ₹5 crore revenue par ₹10 lakh matlab sirf 2% margin aur ek kharab mahina loss me le jaayega. Kyunki interest aur tax isse bahar hain, isliye karz-free company aur karz wali company ko same basis par compare kiya ja sakta hai — isi wajah se lenders aur buyers isko use karte hain.
ebitda.formula: EBITDA = Revenue − Cost of Goods Sold − Operating Expenses. Margin = EBITDA ÷ Revenue × 100, aur tool isko rupee figure ke saath dikhata hai. Inputs hain rev, cogs aur opex. Interest, tax, depreciation aur amortisation jaan-bujhkar chhod diye jaate hain, isliye EBITDA aapki jeb me aane wala cash nahi hai — ye business chalane se mila profit hai, financing aur accounting ke faislon se pehle. 15% se upar ka margin aam taur par achha maana jaata hai; 5% se neeche kharab quarter ke liye jagah nahi bachti.
when: Jab aap investor ko apna business dikha rahe ho aur core profitability ka saaf number chahiye.
Jab aap do business compare kar rahe ho jo alag-alag tarike se funded hain.
Jab aap khud dekhna chahte ho ki kharab mahine me bhi operation paisa bana raha hai ya nahi.
mistakes: Revenue ko EBITDA samajh lena. ₹5 crore sales par 2% margin sirf ₹10 lakh chhodta hai, aur ek bura mahina usko kha jaata hai.
Interest aur tax ko operating cost me ghusa dena. Ye financing aur tax charges hain, trading cost nahi, isliye inko milaane se margin kam dikhta hai.
Ek hi quarter dekh kar margin par faisla karna. One-off cost aur seasonality se number hilta rehta hai, trend par bharosa karo.

ebitdamul.what: EBITDA Multiple valuation ko EBITDA se divide karta hai — earnings before interest, tax, depreciation aur amortisation. Chhote business deals me zyadatar price isi multiple par tay hota hai, kyunki ye ignore karta hai ki current owner ne business ko kaise finance kiya aur accountant ne equipment ki cost kaise phailayi. Do same dukaan, alag loan aur alag depreciation policy ke saath, ek hi EBITDA dikhati hain, isliye multiple like-to-like compare karta hai.
ebitdamul.formula: EBITDA Multiple = Valuation ÷ EBITDA. Tool aapki valuation ko EBITDA se divide karke times me dikhata hai. 6x ka matlab hai buyer saalana operating profit ke har ek rupaye par chhah rupaye de raha hai. Kyunki EBITDA profit ka measure hai aur revenue nahi, isliye same deal par ye multiple revenue multiple se hamesha kam hota hai.
when: Jab aap business bech ya kharid rahe ho aur aisa price chahiye jo lender ya investor ko normal lage.
Jab aap kisi offer ko 4-8x range se compare kar rahe ho jisme zyadatar chhote business deals aate hain.
Jab aap dekhna chahte ho ki asking price sahi lagne ke liye business ko kitna EBITDA chahiye.
mistakes: Aisi costs add back karna jo asli hain. Owner ne khud ko salary na dekar jo one-off bachat ki, wo permanent add-back nahi hoti, aur buyers usse discount karte hain.
EBITDA multiple ko revenue multiple se compare karna. Dono alag cheez naapte hain; 6x EBITDA price, 3x revenue price se 'sasta' nahi hai bina margin dekhe.
Purana EBITDA use karna. Ek achha saal multiple ke denominator ko badha deta hai aur average business sasta dikhta hai.

emi.what: Loan EMI Calculator ek loan ki fixed monthly payment nikalta hai — amount, interest rate aur tenure ke hisaab se. Work out the fixed monthly payment for a loan, based on amount, rate and duration. Yahi number aapki monthly budget tay karta hai, isliye isse pehle jaanna zaroori hai ki aap kya commit kar rahe ho.
emi.formula: EMI ka formula hai: P x r x (1+r)^n ÷ ((1+r)^n - 1), jahan P loan amount hai, r monthly interest rate (saalana rate ÷ 12 ÷ 100), aur n kitne mahine. Kyunki EMI me byaaj aur principal dono hote hain, shuru ke mahinon me zyadatar hissa byaaj jaata hai. Isliye tenure badhane se EMI kam hoti hai lekin kul byaaj kaafi zyada ho jaata hai.
when: Jab aap home, car ya personal loan lene se pehle monthly commitment jaanna chahte ho.
Jab aap dekhan chahte ho ki tenure badhane se EMI kitni girti hai aur kul byaaj kitna badhta hai.
Jab aap do banks ke offers compare kar rahe ho.
mistakes: Sirf EMI dekhna aur kul byaaj na dekhna. Lambi tenure sasti lagti hai, hoti nahi.
Ye bhool jaana ki floating rate hone par EMI ya tenure aage badal sakti hai.
Budget me sirf EMI rakhna, processing fee aur insurance ke liye jagah na chhodna.

epf.what: EPF calculator har mahine aapke PF account mein chup-chaap jo paisa jama hota hai, uska jod lagata hai aur retirement tak woh kitna banega, dikhata hai. Isme do log daalte hain - aap aur aapka employer - aur dono ka paisa interest kamata hai, asli chaunkane wali baat yahi hai. Employee share basic salary ka 12% hota hai, employer utna hi daalta hai, aur balance saal-dar-saal compound hota rehta hai. Jo 25 par join karke 58 par retire hota hai, usne 33 saal paisa daala hai - aur aakhri das saal ka interest akela pehle bees saal ki contribution se zyada hota hai.
epf.formula: Saalana jama = (Employee Monthly PF + Employer Monthly PF) × 12, aur balance EPF rate par saalana compound hota hai. Agar aap aur employer milaakar ₹10,000 mahina daalte ho 8.25% par, toh 30 saal baad corpus takreeban ₹1.42 crore banta hai - jisme sirf ₹36 lakh woh paisa hai jo aapne actually daala. Baaki compound interest hai, aur yahi poora reason hai jaldi shuru karne ka, baad mein zyada daalne ka nahi.
when: Retirement tak PF kitna banega ye jaan-na ho, isse pehle ki aur kahaan bachana hai woh decide karo.
Job switch kar rahe ho aur dekhna hai ki balance chhedne se kitna nuksan hota hai.
PF ko NPS, PPF ya equity SIP se barabar ki taur par compare karna ho.
mistakes: Sirf apni contribution jodna aur employer ka share bhool jaana - isse andar jaane wala paisa takreeban dugna hota hai.
Interest rate fix maan lena. EPF rate har saal review hota hai aur ek dashak se 8% se 8.5% ke beech ghoom raha hai.
EPS split ignore karna - employer ke share ka ek hissa pension mein jaata hai, us PF balance mein nahi jo interest kamata hai.

exitcalc.what: Exit calculator dikhata hai ki company bikne par founder ya angel investor ke haath actually kitna aata hai. News mein jo headline number hota hai woh company ka price hai; jo aapke bank account tak pahunchta hai woh uska aapka equity percentage hai, aur dono bilkul alag hain. Agar aapki ₹4.5 crore ki company mein 18% hai, toh payout ₹81 lakh hai - ₹4.5 crore nahi. Founders saalon valuation par bahas karte hain aur cap table par waqt nahi dete, jabki wahi document us din yeh number tay karta hai.
exitcalc.formula: Payout = Exit Valuation × Your Equity %. ₹25 crore ki sale mein 12% hissa ₹3 crore deta hai. Wahi 12% ₹4.5 crore ki sale mein ₹54 lakh. Asli deals mein do cheezein chup-chaap isse kam karti hain: sale se thoda pehle banaya gaya ESOP pool, aur liquidation preference, jisme investors founders se pehle apna paisa le lete hain. Down-round sale mein preference founder ka payout poora kha sakti hai, chahe equity percentage kagaz par theek dikhe.
when: Acquisition offer aaya hai aur jawab dene se pehle apna number chahiye.
Aur raise karna hai ya abhi bechna hai - dono raaste kitna dete hain ye dekhna hai.
Angel investor ho aur diye hue exit par apne stake ka return nikaalna hai.
mistakes: Company ka sale price apna payout maan lena. Sirf aapka equity percentage aapka hai.
Liquidation preference bhool jaana - ye investors ko pehle milti hai aur chhoti sale mein founders ko kuch nahi bach sakta.
Aaj se exit tak ki dilution ignore karna - har future round aaj ka percentage chhota kar deta hai.

fd.what: Fixed deposit ek fixed rate, fixed term ke liye deti hai, aur nateeje ko asli badalne wala decision sirf ek hai - interest reinvest ho raha hai ya nahi. 1,00,000 rupaye 7% par 5 saal me simple terms me 35,000 deta hai, par 40,255 agar interest quarterly compound ho - aur banks default me quarterly compound karte hain. Calculator dono dikhata hai, saath me post-tax figure, kyunki 40,000 rupaye saalana interest se upar TDS hi 7% FD ko 30% slab wale ke liye lagbhag 4.9% bana deta hai.
fd.formula: Maturity = P x (1 + r / n)^(n x t), jahan r annual rate, n saal me compounds (quarterly ke liye 4) aur t saal. Interest = Maturity - P.
when: Aap lump sum park kar rahe ho aur advertised rate nahi, post-tax maturity chahiye.
Bank FD ko us small-finance bank FD se compare kar rahe ho jo 0.5-1% zyada deta hai.
3 saal aur 5 saal ki FD me choose kar rahe ho aur rupee ka farak chahiye.
mistakes: FD rate ko equity fund ke return se compare karna. FD contractual hai; fund nahi.
TDS ignore karna. 30% slab wale ke liye FD ka asli return lagbhag rate minus 30% hota hai.
FD beech me todna bina penalty dekhe - aksar rate ka 0.5-1% lagta hai.

franchise.what: Franchise ya store ROI calculator wahi ek sawaal ka jawab deta hai jo kholne ka faisla karta hai: paisa wapas aane mein kitna waqt lagega? Store ki upfront cost - franchise fee, deposit, fit-out, shuru ka stock - badi hoti hai aur zyadatar sunk, aur monthly profit usi ko wapas karta hai. ₹25 lakh mein khulne wala outlet jo ₹1.5 lakh mahina kamata hai, takreeban 17 mahine mein payback karta hai, aur yahi number franchise agreement ki term se compare karna hai.
franchise.formula: Payback Period mahino mein = Starting Investment ÷ Monthly Profit. ₹25 lakh investment, ₹1,50,000 mahina profit: takreeban 17 mahine mein payback. ROI matlab saalana profit divided by investment: ₹18,00,000 ÷ ₹25,00,000 = 72% saalana, jo shaandaar lagta hai jab tak check na karo ki ₹1.5 lakh realistic mahina hai ya best mahina. Agreement ki term se aage payback matlab model kaam nahi karta.
when: Franchise offer evaluate kar rahe ho aur sign karne se pehle payback chahiye.
Do locations compare kar rahe ho jinke rent aur expected sales alag hain.
Doosra outlet kholna hai ya nahi ye decide kar rahe ho.
mistakes: Franchisor ke projected sales use karna, apne conservative figure ki jagah.
Working capital investment se bahar chhod dena. Store ko stock aur cash chahiye isse pehle ki woh kamaye.
Royalty aur marketing fees ignore karna, jo monthly profit se pehle nikal jaati hain.

freelance.what: Freelancer hourly rate calculator nikalta hai ki target income tak pahunchne ke liye aapko per hour kitna charge karna chahiye - aur jawab hamesha freelancers ke pehle anumaan se zyada hota hai. Wajah ye hai ki freelancer ke billable ghante kaam ke ghanton ka ek hissa hi hote hain. Sales, invoicing, seekhna, admin aur projects ke beech ke gaps - sab asli waqt hai jiska koi paisa nahi deta, aur 40-ghante ke week par set kiya rate aisa rate hai jo aapko underpaid chhod dega.
freelance.formula: Hourly Rate = Target Monthly Income ÷ Billable Hours per Month. ₹1,00,000 mahina chahiye, 40 ghante hafta kaam par unme sirf 50% billable, aur 4 hafte: 80 billable ghante. ₹1,00,000 ÷ 80 = ₹1,250 ghanta. ₹800 charge karo toh ₹64,000 kamayenge, chahe kitni bhi mehnat karo. Billable percentage wahi number hai jise freelancers lagataar zyada aankte hain.
when: Client ko quote kar rahe ho aur aisa rate chahiye jo actually pay kare.
Job se freelancing par aa rahe ho aur purani salary match karni hai.
Faisla karna hai ki diye gaye price par project lena worth hai ya nahi.
mistakes: Maanna ki har kaam ka ghanta billable hai. Zyadatar freelancers best case 50% se 70% hi bill karte hain.
Rate competitor ke price se set karna, apni zaroori income se nahi.
Tax bhool jaana, aur ye ki aap khud apna PF, insurance aur chhuttiyan dete ho.

funnel.what: Marketing funnel calculator dikhata hai ki aap har step par kitna dete ho - per click, per lead aur per sale - taaki saaf dikhe ki paisa kahaan leak ho raha hai. Har stage ki apni cost hoti hai, aur har stage ki cost pichhli stage divided by uske conversion rate hoti hai. Zyadatar businesses ad spend aur sales jaante hain aur beech mein kuch nahi, jisse ye pata karna namumkin ho jaata hai ki problem ad hai, landing page hai ya follow-up.
funnel.formula: CPC = Ad Spend ÷ Clicks. CPL = Ad Spend ÷ Leads. CPA = Ad Spend ÷ Conversions. ₹50,000 se 2,500 clicks, 250 leads aur 25 sales: CPC ₹20, CPL ₹200 aur CPA ₹2,000. Ab dikh jaata hai ki lead-to-sale rate 20% karne se CPA ₹1,000 ho jaata hai - jo CPC aadha karne se kaafi sasta hai.
when: Campaign profitable nahi hai aur dhoondhna hai kaunsa stage fail ho raha hai.
Launch se pehle CPC, CPL aur CPA ke targets set kar rahe ho.
Do channels compare kar rahe ho jo sirf ad spend par same lagte hain.
mistakes: CPC sudharna jab leak funnel mein neeche hai. Jo sasta click kabhi convert nahi hota, bekaar hai.
Channel ko last click par measure karna jab customer ne pehle teen touchpoints dekhe the.
CPA channels ke beech compare karna bina ye dekhe ki har channel ka customer kaisa hai.

gratuity.what: Gratuity wo lump sum hai jo employer tab deta hai jab aap paanch saal ya zyada ki continuous service ke baad job chhodte ho. Ye last drawn basic salary plus dearness allowance par banti hai, aapki poori monthly CTC par nahi - aur yahi ek baat log sabse zyada galat samajhte hain. Ye calculator Payment of Gratuity Act ke hisaab se statutory figure nikaalta hai, aapki salary aur completed years se, taki offer letter ya settlement se pehle number saamne ho.
gratuity.formula: Gratuity = last drawn basic + DA, guna 15, bhag 26, guna completed years. 15/26 statutory rate hai: har completed saal ke liye pandrah din ki salary, jahan mahina 26 working days ka maana jaata hai. To 50,000 basic plus DA aur 10 completed years par: 50,000 x 15 / 26 x 10 = 2,88,461. Act ke bahar wale employers bhi practically yahi 15/26 lagate hain, par salary base aur part-year ki rounding alag ho sakti hai.
when: Resign ya retire kar rahe ho aur HR ke settlement se pehle figure chahiye.
Do offers compare kar rahe ho aur dono ke end me gratuity kitni hogi, dekhna hai.
Final settlement letter ko statutory formula se check kar rahe ho.
mistakes: Poori CTC ko salary maan lena. Gratuity sirf basic plus DA par banti hai, isliye CTC-based estimate kaafi zyada aa jaata hai.
Part-years ko poore saal ginna. Sirf completed years ginte hain, jab tak paanchve saal me 240 din ya zyada service na ho.
Paanch saal se pehle gratuity ki ummeed rakhna. Paanch saal se kam continuous service par statutory haq banta hi nahi.

gross.what: Gross profit matlab sales mein se jo bacha us cheez ki cost nikalne ke baad jo aapne bechi, aur gross margin wahi number percentage mein. Yeh pehli profit line hai aur sabse honest, kyunki isme kuch chhupa nahi hota. Dukaan ₹1,000 ka product bechti hai jiski cost ₹600 thi, toh gross profit ₹400 aur gross margin 40%. Woh ₹400 abhi aapka profit nahi - kiraya, salary aur marketing isme se nikalna baaki hai - par agar 40% shuru mein nahi hai, toh baad mein kitni bhi cost-cutting se fix nahi hoga. Gross margin batata hai ki business chal sakta hai ya nahi.
gross.formula: Gross Profit = Revenue − Cost of Goods Sold. Gross Margin % = (Gross Profit ÷ Revenue) × 100. ₹10 lakh revenue aur ₹6 lakh COGS par ₹4 lakh gross profit aur 40% margin. Healthy margin business par depend karta hai: physical products aksar 40% se 60%, food 60% se 70%, software 70% ya zyada. D2C brand jo 25% gross margin par bech raha hai, woh aksar mushkil mein hai, kyunki akela ad spend poora kha sakta hai.
when: Product ki pricing kar rahe ho aur dekhna hai ki price se kitna margin bachta hai.
Do products compare kar rahe ho aur jaan-na hai kaunsa push karne layak hai.
Investor ke liye numbers taiyaar kar rahe ho aur pehli profit line sahi chahiye.
mistakes: Gross profit ko apna profit kehna. Kiraya, salary, marketing aur tax abhi isme se nikalna baaki hai.
Delivery, packaging aur payment gateway fees COGS se bahar chhod dena. D2C brand ke liye ye sale ki asli cost ka hissa hain.
Apne margin ko software company se compare karna. Ek hi percentage ka matlab alag business mein bilkul alag hota hai.

gst.what: GST calculator wahi do kaam karta hai jo aapko hamesha chahiye: price par GST jodkar final bill nikalna, aur aisi amount se GST nikaalna jisme woh pehle se shaamil hai. Doosri direction hi logon ko phasati hai, kyunki GST-inclusive price ke andar base chhota hota hai jitna woh dikhta hai. India mein rate state ke andar bikri par CGST aur SGST mein bat jaata hai, ya state ke bahar bikri par ek IGST - par total wahi rehta hai.
gst.formula: GST Amount = Base Price × GST Rate ÷ 100, aur final price Base + GST hai. ₹1,000 base par 18% GST = ₹180 aur ₹1,180 ka bill. Ulta: agar bill 18% GST ke saath ₹1,180 hai, toh base 1,180 ÷ 1.18 = ₹1,000 aur tax ₹180 hai.
