Ulta direction division use karti hai, subtraction nahi - ₹1,180 se 18% ghatao toh ₹967.60 aata hai, jo galat hai.
when: Invoice bana rahe ho aur GST amount aur total chahiye.
Price inclusive batayi gayi hai aur base aur tax alag karne hain.
GST-inclusive price ko GST-exclusive se compare karna hai.
mistakes: Inclusive price se GST rate ghata dena, (1 + rate) se divide karne ki jagah. Isse base hamesha kam aata hai.
Ye bhool jaana ki supply se pehle discount dene par GST discounted price par lagti hai, par baad mein dene par poori price par.
GST ko apna paisa samajh lena. Woh sarkar ke liye rakha jaata hai aur dena padta hai.

gst_taxwealth.what: Yeh GST calculator thoda messy asli case sambhalta hai: pehle discount lagta hai, phir bache hue par GST lagti hai, aur tax aapke liye CGST aur SGST mein bat jaati hai. Order maayne rakhta hai. 10% discount ke baad 18% GST ka jawab gross par pehle 18% GST aur baad mein 10% discount se alag hota hai, aur galat order ka matlab invoice aapki books se match nahi karega.
gst_taxwealth.formula: Discounted Base = Base Amount × (1 − Discount %). GST = Discounted Base × GST Rate. Total = Discounted Base + GST, jisme intra-state sale par CGST aur SGST dono rate ke aadhe-aadhe. ₹10,000 base, 10% discount aur 18% GST: base ₹9,000 ho jaata hai, GST ₹1,620 jo ₹810 CGST aur ₹810 SGST mein bat jaati hai, aur invoice total ₹10,620.
when: Trade discount ke saath invoice issue kar rahe ho aur uspar GST.
Intra-state sale ke liye CGST aur SGST split chahiye.
GST-inclusive amount se base reverse nikaalna hai.
mistakes: Pre-discount amount par GST lagana. Invoice par dikhaye gaye discount par GST discounted value par lagti hai.
Inter-state sale mein tax barabar baant dena - wahan poore rate par IGST hona chahiye, CGST plus SGST nahi.
CGST aur SGST alag-alag round karke total ko invoice se ek-do rupee hilne dena.

homeemi.what: Home loan EMI calculator housing loan ki fixed monthly payment dikhata hai, aur usse zyada zaroori - loan aapko kul kitne ka padta hai. EMI ke do hisse hote hain - byaaj aur principal - aur shuru ke saalon mein lagbhag poora byaaj hi hota hai. Isliye 8.5% par 20 saal ka loan borrow ki gayi rakam se kaafi zyada padta hai, aur isliye shuru ke saalon mein chhoti prepayment baad mein utni hi rakam dene se kaafi zyada bachaati hai.
homeemi.formula: EMI = P × r × (1+r)^n ÷ ((1+r)^n − 1), jahan P loan amount hai, r monthly interest rate (saalana rate ÷ 12 ÷ 100) aur n mahine. ₹50 lakh loan 8.5% par 20 saal: EMI takreeban ₹43,391, aur poori term mein kul takreeban ₹1.04 crore - lagbhag dugna. Wahi loan 30 saal par EMI takreeban ₹38,446 kar deta hai par kul cost takreeban ₹1.38 crore.
when: Do banks ke offers alag rates aur tenure par compare kar rahe ho.
Jaanna hai ki lambi tenure aapko kul byaaj mein kitna padti hai.
Faisla karna hai ki extra paisa prepay karna hai ya invest.
mistakes: Sabse kam EMI ke liye sabse lambi tenure chunna. Monthly bachat chhoti hoti hai aur extra byaaj bada.
Ye ignore karna ki floating rate par EMI ya tenure badal sakti hai, aur total fix nahi hai.
Processing fees, insurance aur loan agreement ki stamp duty bhool jaana, jo EMI mein nahi aate.

hra.what: HRA exemption calculator nikalta hai ki house rent allowance ka kitna hissa tax se bachta hai, aur zyadatar salaried log apne haq se kam claim karte hain. Exemption teen amounts mein sabse chhoti hoti hai: jo HRA actually milta hai, jo kiraya dete ho minus basic salary ka 10%, aur basic salary ka 50% agar metro mein rehte ho warna 40%. Kyunki sabse chhoti chunti hai, sabse kamzor kadi aapki exemption tay karti hai - isliye kiraya badhane se exemption sirf ek had tak badhti hai.
hra.formula: Exemption = inme sabse kam: (1) HRA received, (2) Rent paid − 10% of basic salary, (3) metro mein basic ka 50% ya warna 40%. Agar basic ₹6 lakh, HRA ₹3 lakh aur kiraya ₹2.4 lakh: option 2 ₹2.4 lakh − ₹60,000 = ₹1.8 lakh, option 3 metro mein ₹3 lakh, aur exemption sabse chhoti - ₹1.8 lakh. Dhyan rahe ye sirf old regime mein chalta hai.
when: Kiraya dete ho aur filing se pehle jaanna hai kitni exemption claim karni hai.
Old aur new tax regime mein se chun rahe ho aur comparison ke liye HRA figure chahiye.
Salary structure negotiate kar rahe ho aur HRA ki value dekhni hai.
mistakes: New regime mein HRA claim karna, jahan ye milta hi nahi.
Poora HRA exempt maan lena. Yeh teen amounts mein sabse chhoti hai, aur rent minus basic ka 10% aksar binding hota hai.
Ye bhool jaana ki family ko kiraya dena sirf tab allowed hai jab kiraya actually diya jaaye aur landlord income declare kare.

importduty.what: Import duty calculator nikalta hai ki customs se clear hone tak ek imported consignment ki asli cost kitni hoti hai - aur jawab hamesha invoice se zyada hota hai. Pehle customs duty lagti hai, phir IGST value plus duty par lagti hai, isliye dono jodne ke bajaye compound ho jaate hain. ₹1 lakh ka shipment, 20% duty aur 18% IGST: cost ₹1.38 lakh nahi, ₹1.42 lakh hoti hai, kyunki IGST ₹1 lakh par nahi, ₹1.2 lakh par lagti hai. Patle import margin par yahi gap decide karta hai ki product bikta hai ya nahi.
importduty.formula: Customs Duty = Product Value × Duty Rate. IGST = (Product Value + Customs Duty) × IGST Rate. Landed cost = Product Value + Customs Duty + IGST. ₹1,00,000 par 20% duty: duty ₹20,000, IGST ₹1,20,000 ka 18% = ₹21,600, landed cost ₹1,41,600. Duty rate product ke HSN code par depend karta hai, isliye price tay karne se pehle apne item ka exact rate confirm karo.
when: Import kar rahe ho aur selling price tay karne se pehle asli cost chahiye.
Imported product ko locally bane product se compare kar rahe ho.
Shipment aa gaya aur customs bill expectation se zyada hai - dekhna hai kyun.
mistakes: IGST sirf product value par lagana. Yeh value plus duty par lagti hai, isliye bill simple jod se hamesha bada aata hai.
Exact HSN code rate ke bajaye mota-moti duty rate use karna. Do codes ke beech 10 percentage point se zyada ka farq ho sakta hai.
Ye bhool jaana ki customs duty akela charge nahi hai - social welfare surcharge aur clearance charges bhi lagte hain.

impval.what: Implied valuation matlab ek chhote deal se poori company ki value ulti nikaalna. Jab koi kehta hai "50 lakh for 5%", wo actually bata deta hai ki uske hisaab se company kitne ki hai: 50 lakh company ka 5% hai, matlab company ₹10 crore ki hai. Ye number kisi ne likha nahi hota - deal se implied hai. Yahi poori baat hai, aur kisi bhi offer ko turant check karne ka ye sabse tez tareeka hai, kyunki jaan-boojh kar offer dene wala aksar ye nahi samajhta ki usne apna number bata diya.
impval.formula: Implied Valuation = Investment ÷ Equity % × 100. "50 lakh for 5%" matlab 50,00,000 ÷ 5 × 100 = ₹10 crore. Ulta karne par implied equity milti hai: Investment ÷ Valuation × 100. Yahi formula pre-money aur post-money ke peeche bhi hai - implied valuation bas offer se ulta chalane par milti hai.
when: Koi price aur stake saath me bolta hai - "2 crore for 10%" - aur aap uske peeche ki company value jaanna chahte ho.
Do offers alag-alag stake par compare kar rahe ho aur ek number chahiye.
Investor bolta hai company ki value X hai aur aap check karna chahte ho ki uske cheque ke liye iska matlab kya hai.
mistakes: Implied number ko post-money maan lena jab investor pre-money bol raha ho. Farak cheque ka hai, aur wo asli equity hai.
Aise deal par ganit chalana jisme royalty ya loan hai - wo equity nahi hai, isliye equity alag kiye bina implied valuation ka koi matlab nahi.
Implied valuation ko certified valuation bata dena. Ye offer ka reading hai, registered valuation nahi - official kaam ke liye CA ya merchant banker chahiye.

incometax.what: Old vs new regime calculator batata hai ki is saal India ke do income tax systems mein se kaunsa aapse kam leta hai - aur jawab lagbhag har salary ke saath badalta hai. New regime slab rates kam deta hai par zyadatar deductions chheen leta hai. Old regime ke rates zyada hain par 80C, 80D, HRA aur home loan interest tax se pehle ghata sakte ho. Isliye comparison rates ka nahi hai - ye dekhna hai ki aapke deductions rate cut ko beat karte hain ya nahi. Jiske paas investments nahi, woh lagbhag hamesha new regime mein better hai; jiske paas bada home loan aur poora 80C hai, woh aksar old regime mein.
incometax.formula: Old regime: (Income − Deductions) par purane slabs se tax. New regime: Income par naye slabs se tax, lagbhag bina deductions. Jo tax kam, wahi jeeta. Saada ₹15 lakh salary, koi investment nahi: new regime aksar kam hota hai, kyunki ghata-ne ke liye zyada kuch hai hi nahi. ₹2 lakh home loan interest aur poora ₹1.5 lakh 80C jodo, toh old regime aage nikal sakta hai. Yahi crossover dhoondhna calculator ka kaam hai.
when: Employer saal ke shuru mein regime chunne bolta hai aur guess nahi karna.
Home loan liya ya 80C investments shuru kiye aur jawab badal gaya ho.
Do job offers compare kar rahe ho jinme salary structure alag hai.
mistakes: New regime ko hamesha better maan lena kyunki rates kam dikhte hain. Yeh sirf tab better hai jab deductions chhote hain.
Ye bhool jaana ki new regime mein standard deduction milta hai par 80C, 80D ya HRA nahi.
Pichhle saal ke numbers is saal ke slabs se compare karna. Dono regimes aur unke slabs pichhle kuch saalon mein ek se zyada baar badle hain.

landed.what: Landed cost matlab product ko apne warehouse tak laane ki asli kul cost, aur yeh lagbhag hamesha invoice se zyada hoti hai. Manufacturing pehli line hi hai - packaging, freight, insurance, customs clearance aur godown tak ki last-mile delivery sab usi unit par aate hain. Jo founder sirf manufacturing cost se price karta hai, usse mahino baad pata chalta hai ki woh loss par bech raha tha, kyunki jo number use kiya woh asli cost hi nahi thi.
landed.formula: Landed Cost per Unit = (Manufacturing + Packaging + Shipping + Other Costs) ÷ Units. 1,000 units ka batch, banane mein ₹4,00,000, pack karne mein ₹40,000, ship karne mein ₹60,000 aur baaki ₹30,000: (4,00,000 + 40,000 + 60,000 + 30,000) ÷ 1,000 = ₹530 per unit. Agar aap ₹500 par bech rahe the, toh har sale par ₹30 ka loss tha - aur yahi nikaalna is calculator ka poora point hai.
when: Selling price set kar rahe ho aur ek unit ki asli cost chahiye.
Domestic supplier ko imported supplier se compare kar rahe ho.
Check karna hai ki koi product line actually paisa bana rahi hai ya nahi.
mistakes: Manufacturing cost se price karna aur freight aur clearance chhod dena.
Tooling jaise one-off costs ko ek hi batch par baant dena, un volumes par nahi jinme woh kaam karenge.
Ye bhool jaana ki import par di gayi duties aur taxes baad mein credit ho sakti hain, isliye cash cost aur asli cost alag hote hain.

landunits.what: Land area unit converter square feet ko un units mein badalta hai jinme India mein zameen actually bikti hai - square yards, square metres, aur woh traditional units jo bahut states mein property deals par raaj karte hain: guntha, cent, bigha aur acre. Yeh maayne rakhta hai kyunki ek unit mein bataya plot aur doosre unit se compare karna barabar ka comparison nahi hai, aur traditional units state-dar-state badalte hain, toh ek state ka bigha doosre state ka bigha nahi hai.
landunits.formula: 1 square yard = 9 square feet. 1 square metre = 10.764 square feet. 1 acre = 43,560 square feet, matlab 4,840 square yards. 1 guntha = 1,089 square feet, toh 40 guntha ka ek acre. 1 cent = 435.6 square feet, toh 100 cent ka ek acre. 2,400 square feet ka plot 266.7 square yards ya takreeban 223 square metres hai - kaam ka jab buyer aur seller ek hi zameen ke liye alag units bol rahe hon.
when: Plot ek unit mein bataya hai aur doosre se compare karna hai.
Sale deed ya 7/12 extract padh rahe ho aur area apni samajh ke unit mein chahiye.
Listing ke liye traditional units aur square feet ke beech convert karna hai.
mistakes: Maanna ki bigha ya guntha poore India mein same hai. Ye units state aur kabhi district ke hisaab se badalte hain.
Square feet aur square yards mix kar dena, jinme nau guna ka farq hai.
Area convert karna par survey number aur boundaries deed se check na karna.

lovefun.what: Love calculator ek mazaak hai - do naam lete hain, unhe letter-based formula se chalata hai, aur compatibility percentage deta hai. Yeh psychology, astrology ya koi bhi claim wali cheez nahi hai, aur ise rishte ke baare mein salah nahi samajhna chahiye. Yeh sirf isliye hai kyunki logon ko maza aata hai, aur calculator site par kuch aise tools hone chahiye jo sirf entertainment hain. Tank Metrics ise jaan-boojh kar entertainment likhta hai.
lovefun.formula: Score isse aata hai ki do naamon ke letters 'loves' phrase mein kitni baar aate hain, totals ko weight diya jaata hai, aur result percentage mein ghata diya jaata hai. Isme koi science nahi hai - wahi do naam hamesha wahi number dete hain, aur yahi iski ekmaatra consistency hai. Output ko party trick samjho, prediction nahi.
when: Group chat ke liye halka-phulka jawab chahiye.
Jaanna hai ki wahi do naam dobara kitna score karte hain.
Kuch quick aur harmless share karna hai.
mistakes: Result ko seriously lena. Yeh entertainment hai aur bas wahi.
Kam score se kuch matlab nikaalna. Iska koi aadhaar nahi hai.
Iska use asli rishte ke baare mein koi faisla karne ke liye karna.

ltv.what: Customer Lifetime Value batati hai ki ek customer poori rishtedaari me aapke liye kitne ka hai, sirf pehli sale ka nahi. Average order value, saal me kitni baar kharidta hai, kitne saal rukta hai, aur gross margin - inhe ek rupee figure me badal deti hai. Customer ₹1,000 ka saal me 4 baar, 3 saal, 50% margin pe - matlab ₹6,000 ka profit. LTV hi wo chhat hai jitna aap customer jeetne me kharch kar sakte ho; isse zyada diya toh har naya customer aapko garib karta hai.
ltv.formula: LTV = Average Order Value × Saal me Purchases × Customer Lifespan (saal) × Gross Margin %. Margin maayne rakhta hai: ₹12,000 kharch karne wala customer 10% margin pe sirf ₹1,200 ka hai, ₹12,000 ka nahi. ₹1,000 × 4 × 3 × 50% = ₹6,000. Margin hi revenue ko us profit me badalta hai jo acquisition chukata hai.
when: Tay kar rahe ho ki per customer kitna ad spend kar sakte ho.
Investor unit economics maangta hai aur LTV ko CAC ke saath dekhna hai.
High-margin niche aur high-volume business ke beech chunna hai.
mistakes: Revenue ko LTV maan lena - LTV gross margin pe banna chahiye, warna customer ki value zyada dikhti hai.
Ye maan lena ki customer saalon rukta hai kyunki kuch loyal hain; average lifespan aksar bahut kam hota hai.
Sirf pehli kharid ko lifetime value keh dena.

ltvcac.what: LTV:CAC ratio dono unit-economics numbers ko saath rakhta hai aur scaling ka ek hi asli sawaal ka jawab deta hai: customer jeetne ke har rupee pe kitne rupee profit wapas aate hain? Lifetime value ko acquisition cost se divide karo. 3:1 ya usse upar aam rule hai - 1:1 se neeche har customer pe nuksaan, aur 1 se 3 ke beech aap growth ke liye zyada kharch kar rahe ho. ₹4,50,000 ki LTV aur ₹1,80,000 ke CAC pe ratio 2.5:1 hai - theek, par abhi aaramdayak nahi.
ltvcac.formula: LTV : CAC = Customer Lifetime Value ÷ Customer Acquisition Cost. Dono taraf ek hi period aur ek hi basis pe hona chahiye - profit to profit. ₹4,50,000 LTV pe ₹1,80,000 CAC matlab 2.5 : 1. 1:1 se neeche business har sale pe paisa khota hai; 3:1 aur upar wo range hai jo investors dekhte hain.
when: Fundraise ki taiyari kar rahe ho aur unit-economics slide sahi chahiye.
Ad spend badhane wale ho aur jaanna hai ki ab bhi faayda hai.
Pehle margin theek karein ya acquisition cost, ye chunna hai.
mistakes: Revenue-based LTV ko fully-loaded CAC se compare karna - ratio theek dikhta hai jabki business paisa khota hai.
Blended CAC use karna jo wo channel chhupa deta hai jahan har customer pe nuksaan ho.
3:1 ko niyam maan lena; low-margin business ko zyada ratio chahiye, sticky business kam me chal jaata hai.

luckynumber.what: Yahan lucky number aapki poori date of birth se banta hai, ek single digit me. Din, mahina aur saal ke saare digits jodo — 15-06-1995 ka matlab 1+5+0+6+1+9+9+5 = 36 — phir 36 ke digits jodo, 3+6 = 9, aur yeh karte raho jab tak 1 se 9 ke beech ek digit bache. Wahi aakhri digit tool aapka lucky number kehta hai. Yeh ek hi date ko hamesha ek hi tarah padhta hai, isliye ye ek fix personal number hai, roz ka draw nahi.
luckynumber.formula: Tool date of birth se hyphen hata deta hai, saare aath digits jod deta hai, aur agar total nau se bada ho to us total ke digits phir se jod deta hai. 1995-06-15 ka sum 36 banta hai, aur 3+6 se 9. Jaise hi ek single digit 1-9 bachta hai, loop ruk jaata hai — isliye har date nau me se kisi ek number par aati hai.
when: Jab aap profile bhar rahe ho aur birth date se match karne wala number chahiye.
Jab koi apna lucky number bataye aur aap dekhna chahe ki woh kis date se aaya.
Jab aap jaanna chahe ki ek hi din janme do logon ka number same hota hai ya nahi.
mistakes: Date ko jaisa likha hai waise hi jod dena, hyphens ko bhi count karna — unki koi value nahi hoti.
36 jaise do-digit total par ruk jaana, usko 9 tak reduce na karna.
Is number ko bhavishyavani maan lena. Yeh aapki date ka fix reduction hai, aaj ka prediction nahi.

marketplace.what: Marketplace Fee Calculator dikhata hai ki Amazon, Flipkart ya Meesho par order ke baad platform apna hissa kaatne ke baad aapke account me asli kitna aata hai. Commission headline charge hai, par aksar wo akela nahi hota: shipping, closing fee, payment-gateway charge aur koi fixed other fees bhi usi order se nikalte hain. Tool in sab ko selling price se ghata kar wo amount dikhata hai jo aapko milta hai. Yahi number tay karta hai ki product ko us price par list karna theek hai ya nahi.
marketplace.formula: Total fees = selling price x commission rate / 100 + shipping fee + other fees. You receive = selling price minus total fees. Commission selling price par lagta hai, aapki cost par nahi, isliye 1,000 rupaye ke item par 15% commission 150 rupaye hai — chahe aapne use 300 me banaya ho ya 800 me. Apni asli shipping aur other fees daalo, andaaza nahi.
when: Jab aap marketplace ke liye product price kar rahe ho aur gross price nahi, net payout chahiye.
Jab aap ek hi product do marketplaces ke alag fee table par compare kar rahe ho.
Jab commission slab badla ho aur aap dekhna chahte ho ki price ka kitna hissa chala gaya.
mistakes: Sirf commission rate dekhna aur shipping aur closing fee bhool jaana, jo cut ko dugna kar sakte hain.
Ye maan lena ki fee aapki cost par lagti hai. Ye selling price par lagti hai, isliye patla-margin item loss me ja sakta hai.
Commission par GST bhool jaana, jo platform apni fee par leta hai.

marketshare.what: Market share calculator ek saada sawaal ka jawab deta hai: aapke market mein jo kuch bika, usme se kitna aapka hai? Market mein bike total units aur aapke bike units daalo, bas. Market share maayne rakhta hai kyunki yeh aapki growth ko market ki growth ke saath tolta hai - agar aap 20% badhe par market 40% badha, toh aapka share gir gaya, chahe revenue badhi ho. Investors ise dekhkar batate hain ki aap jeet rahe ho ya sirf tez bah rahe ho.
marketshare.formula: Market Share % = (Your Units Sold ÷ Total Market Units) × 100. Aapne 12,000 units beche aur market mein 1,00,000 bike, toh share 12% hai. Value share ke liye wahi formula revenue par lagao. 12% se 15% jaana 3 percentage point ka gain hai par 25% ka rise - aur yeh farq batana zaroori hai kyunki dono sahi lagte hain.
when: Investor ko batana hai ki aap market mein kahaan khade ho.
Apni growth ko market ki growth se compare karna hai.
Kisi naye segment mein enter karne se pehle size dekhni hai.
mistakes: Apna share apne pichhle saal se compare karna aur market ki growth bhool jaana.
Market ko bahut chhota ya bahut bada define karna, jisse share bekaar ho jaata hai.
Volume share aur value share mix kar dena - premium brand ka value share zyada hota hai.

markup.what: Markup aur margin ek hi profit ko batane ke do tareeke hain, aur inhe mix kar dena business ki sabse mehngi chhoti galtiyon mein se ek hai. Markup profit hai aapki cost ka percentage. Margin profit hai aapke selling price ka percentage. Isliye ek hi sale par markup hamesha bada number hota hai. Jo trader markup mein sochta hai par distributor ko margin bata deta hai, woh khud ko 20% kam price par pa sakta hai.
markup.formula: Markup % = (Selling Price − Cost Price) ÷ Cost Price × 100. Margin % = (Selling Price − Cost Price) ÷ Selling Price × 100. ₹600 mein kharido, ₹1,000 mein becho: profit ₹400, jo 66.7% markup hai par sirf 40% margin. Yahi gap hai isliye '40% margin' wala product '40% markup' wala nahi hota, aur dono confuse karne se bade order par asli paisa jaata hai.
when: Product ki pricing kar rahe ho aur profit dono tarah se sahi batana hai.
Buyer margin maang raha hai aur usse woh price nikaalni hai jo charge karni padegi.
Competitor ki pricing se compare kar rahe ho aur barabar ka number chahiye.
mistakes: Buyer ko margin ki jagah markup bata dena, jisse aapki price zyada lagti hai.
Cost par margin jodkar selling price nikaalna, jabki margin selling price ka hissa hota hai.
Ye bhool jaana ki discount dene par dono numbers girti hain, kyunki selling price badal gaya.

moicirr.what: MOIC aur IRR wahi do numbers hain jin par venture investor actually deal judge karta hai. MOIC saada hai: paisa kitne guna wapas aaya. ₹1 daala aur ₹3 mile, matlab 3x. IRR wahi natija saalana rate mein batata hai, aur yahi number do deals ko comparable banata hai. Teen saal mein 3x aur das saal mein 3x bilkul ek achievement nahi hai - pehla takreeban 44% saalana hai, doosra takreeban 12%. Jo founder ye do numbers bolna seekh jaata hai, usse cheque likhne wale galat nahi samajhte.
moicirr.formula: MOIC = Exit Amount ÷ Investment Amount. IRR woh saalana rate hai jisse investment exit value tak pahunchta hai: IRR = (Exit ÷ Investment)^(1 ÷ Years) − 1. ₹1 crore 5 saal mein ₹3 crore: 3x MOIC aur takreeban 24.6% IRR. Wahi ₹3 crore 10 saal mein: 3x MOIC par IRR sirf takreeban 11.6%. Investors aksar 3x ya zyada aur 25% ya behtar chahte hain.
when: Pitch kar rahe ho aur valuation ke saath-saath round ka return dikhana hai.
Do offers compare kar rahe ho jinke amount aur period alag hain.
Apne investors ko report de rahe ho aur MOIC aur IRR sahi likhna hai.
mistakes: Multiple batana par saal nahi. 3x ka koi matlab nahi jab tak period na bolo.
IRR compare karna bina ye note kiye ki IRR maanta hai paisa usi rate par reinvest hota hai, jo aksar nahi hota.
Partial exit par MOIC ko poora picture maan lena - aadha hissa becha toh multiple bhi aadha hi realised hai.

momyoy.what: Month-on-month is mahine ko pichhle mahine se compare karta hai. Year-on-year is mahine ko pichhle saal ke usi mahine se. Lagbhag har Indian business ke liye YoY imaandaar number hai, kyunki Diwali, monsoon aur school calendar demand ko itna hilate hain ki MoM zyada tar festival naapta hai, business nahi. Calculator dono deta hai, aur dono ka gap hi seasonality hai.
momyoy.formula: MoM % = (This Month - Last Month) / Last Month x 100. YoY % = (This Month - Same Month Last Year) / Same Month Last Year x 100.
when: Ek mahina kharab lagta hai aur jaanna hai ki seasonality hai ya asli decline.
Investor ko present karna hai aur festive distortion ke bina growth dikhani hai.
Agle quarter ka target set kar rahe ho aur seasonal baseline chahiye.
mistakes: Festive mahine ki MoM growth ko trend bata dena. October hamesha September se upar hota hai.
31 din ke mahine ko 28 din wale se bina days normalise kiye compare karna.
Ek saal se chhote business par YoY lagana - compare karne ke liye kuch hai hi nahi.

mrpreverse.what: MRP reverse calculator pack par chhapi price se shuru karke ulta nikalta hai ki manufacturer ke roop mein aapko actually kitna milta hai. Yeh direction Indian founders ko sabse zyada chahiye, kyunki market MRP aapse bahut pehle tay kar deta hai - competitor ki ₹499 ki bottle wahi price hai jiske saath aapka product baithna hai. Usse retailer ka cut aur distributor ka cut ghatao, jo bachta hai woh aapka landing price hai. Agar woh number aapki cost se neeche hai, toh kitni bhi volume isse theek nahi karegi.
mrpreverse.formula: Landing Price = MRP × (1 − Retailer Margin %) × (1 − Distributor Margin %). ₹500 MRP, 20% retailer aur 10% distributor margin: ₹500 × 0.80 × 0.90 = ₹360 aapka landing price. Agar cost of goods ₹300 hai, gross margin ₹60 ya 16.7%. Agar cost ₹380 hai, toh har unit par ₹20 ka loss - aur MRP wahi cheez hai jo badalni padegi.
when: Product kis price par bikna chahiye ye pata hai aur usme aapka margin kya bachta hai dekhna hai.
Retailer zyada discount maang raha hai aur dekhna hai factory gate par kitna padta hai.
Ek hi product ke do MRP points compare kar rahe ho.
mistakes: Dono margins MRP se ek saath ghata dena, ek ke baad ek nahi - doosra margin chhote number par lagta hai.
GST bhool jaana, jo zyadatar cases mein MRP ke bahar hota hai aur aap actually kitna collect karte ho woh badalta hai.
Margins fix maan lena. Alag formats ke retailers ek hi product par bilkul alag cut lete hain.

netmargin.what: Net Profit Margin Calculator do figure — revenue aur net profit — ko us ek percentage me badal deta hai jo batata hai ki sales ke har rupaye me se business asli me kitna rakhta hai. Net profit last line hai: cost of goods ke baad, salary aur rent ke baad, loan ke interest ke baad, aur tax ke baad. Isliye ye teen margin numbers me sabse chhota aur sabse sachcha hai.
netmargin.formula: Net margin = net profit ÷ revenue × 100 (`np` ÷ `rev` × 100). Agar business ₹4,50,000 revenue kamaye aur har cost aur tax ke baad ₹1,80,000 bachaye, to net margin 1,80,000 ÷ 4,50,000 = 40% hai. Net profit wo bachta hai jo cost of goods, operating expenses, interest aur tax ke baad rehta hai; inme se koi bhi kam ho to percentage badh jaata hai.
when: Aap jaanna chahein ki sales ke har rupaye me se sab kuch dene ke baad business kitna rakhta hai.
Apne margin ko usi tarah ka product ya service bechne walon se compare kar rahe ho.
Accounts ya pitch taiyaar kar rahe ho aur bottom-line percentage chahiye jo investor poochta hai.
mistakes: Margin ko doosri industry ke business se compare karna. Grocery chain ka 3% theek ho sakta hai jabki software company ka 3% mushkil me hai; sahi comparison apne hi trade me hai.
Profit before tax ko net keh dena. Net matlab tax aur interest ke baad, isliye wahi revenue par operating margin se kam hota hai.
Chhoti revenue par bada percentage dekh kar business ko strong maan lena. ₹4,50,000 ka 40% matlab ₹1,80,000 — chhoti turnover par bada margin bhi chhota profit hi hai.

nps.what: NPS yaani National Pension Scheme, sarkar ka PFRDA ke through chalaya gaya retirement account hai. Aap har saal paisa daalte ho, wo aapke chune equity aur debt funds me invest hota hai, aur 60 saal se pehle nikal nahi sakte. Return fixed nahi hai - funds par depend karta hai. Calculator aapki monthly contribution, umar aur maan liye gaye return se 60 par corpus project karta hai, taaki pata chale ki aaj ki saving se wahi retirement milega ya nahi.
nps.formula: Corpus = Monthly Contribution x [((1 + r)^n - 1) / r] x (1 + r), jahan r monthly rate (annual / 12) aur n 60 tak ke mahine. Iske upar employer ka basic ka 14% (Section 80CCD(2)) aur 80CCD(1B) ke tahat extra 50,000 rupaye ki deduction judti hai.
when: Aap salaried ho aur jaanna chahte ho ki 80CCD(1B) ki extra 50,000 rupaye deduction ki asli value kitni hai.
NPS aur PPF me choose kar rahe ho aur dono ka corpus saath dekhna chahte ho.
Aap dekhna chahte ho ki 10 saal late start karne par kya hota hai - jawab usually brutal hota hai.
mistakes: Calculator ka return guaranteed maan lena. NPS equity funds upar-neeche hote hain; 10% planning number hai, promise nahi.
Ye bhoolna ki 60 par corpus ka 40% annuity kharidna padta hai. Withdraw karne wala lump sum dikhaye corpus se kam hai.
NPS ko sirf tax par ELSS se compare karna. NPS paisa 60 tak lock karta hai; ELSS 3 saal me khulta hai.

numerology.what: Numerology Calculator aapke naam ke letters aur date of birth ko milakar ek digit banata hai. Har letter ko alphabet me uski position ka number bana diya jaata hai — A ka 1, J ka 10, S ka 19 — sab jod diye jaate hain, total ke digits phir jode jaate hain jab tak ek digit bache, aur date of birth bhi isi tarah reduce karke mila di jaati hai. Number naam ki spelling par depend karta hai, isliye 'Aarav' aur 'Aarav ' alag aa sakte hain.
numerology.formula: Naam me se letters aur digits ke alawa sab hata do. Bacha har character ka character code jodo, date of birth ke digits jodo, aur running total ko ek digit tak reduce karo, jab tak 1-9 me se ek number bache. Kyunki character code use hota hai, capital letter aur small letter ek hi number nahi dete.
when: Jab aap naam ki spelling ya baby name chunne ke liye name-based number dekhna chahte ho.
Jab naam aur date dono ho aur aap ek combined number chahte ho, do alag nahi.
Jab aap ek hi naam ki do spellings ka farak dekhna chahte ho.
mistakes: 'Aarav' aur 'aarav' ka same jawab expect karna — tool character code padhta hai, isliye case badalne se number badalta hai.
Middle name chhod dena aur phir sochna ki number kyun badal gaya.
Result ko insaan ke baare me advice samajhna, jabki ye sirf unke hi naam se banaya gaya number hai.

numwords.what: Number to words number ko Indian tareeke se shabdon mein likhta hai - lakh aur crore, million aur billion nahi. Yeh cheque, invoice, legal document, rent agreement aur har aise form ke liye bana hai jisme amount shabdon mein maangta hai. Cheque par amount shabdon mein likhna isliye zaroori hai ki agar figure mein koi badlav ho toh shabd wala version maanya hota hai, aur banks isi ko dekhte hain. Indian numbering system har teen digit par comma lagata hai, isliye yahan million-billion wala conversion seedha kaam nahi karta.
numwords.formula: Indian grouping right se teen digit ke blocks mein hoti hai - pehle hazaar, phir lakh, phir crore. 12,34,567 padha jaata hai 'twelve lakh thirty four thousand five hundred sixty seven'. ₹10,00,000 'ten lakh' hai aur ₹1,00,00,000 'one crore'. Ulta conversion - crore ko million mein badalna - ke liye 1 crore = 10 million aur 1 lakh = 100,000 yaad rakho.
when: Cheque ya demand draft par amount shabdon mein likhni hai.
Legal document ya rent agreement mein figure shabdon mein chahiye.
Kisi foreign document ke liye crore aur lakh ko million mein badalna hai.
mistakes: Million aur billion wala conversion Indian form par lagana, jahan lakh aur crore chahiye.
Comma galat jagah lagana. Indian system 12,34,567 likhta hai, 1,234,567 nahi.
Cheque par figure aur shabd match na hona - aisi cheque bank reject kar sakta hai.

opmargin.what:
Operating Margin batata hai ki business apne trading se paisa bana raha hai ya nahi — us paise ki lagat aur tax se pehle jo usne udhaar liya. Revenue aur operating profit daalo, aur tool dikhata hai ki sales ke har rupee ka kitna hissa bacha. Core operation chalta hai ya nahi, iska ye sabse saaf single reading hai, kyunki financing aur one-off items isse bahar rehte hain.

Farq ye hai ki “operating profit” kya chhodta hai. Loan ka interest is baat ki lagat hai ki business funded kaise hua, na ki wo kya bechta hai; tax company ki poori position par depend karta hai; ek baar wali asset sale trading nahi hai. Ye sab hata do to margin akela engine dikhata hai. Isliye ye EBITDA ke saath rehta hai, uski jagah nahi: EBITDA me depreciation aur amortisation wapas jod diye jaate hain, isliye asset-light business me dono saath chalte hain aur factory wale business me alag ho jaate hain.
opmargin.formula: Operating Margin = Operating Profit ÷ Revenue × 100. Revenue (rev) top line hai; Operating Profit (ebit) wo hai jo cost of goods sold aur operating expenses ke baad bachta hai, lekin interest aur tax se pehle. ₹45,000 revenue par ₹18,000 operating profit matlab 40% margin. 10% se upar aam taur par healthy core maana jaata hai; negative margin matlab operation khud paisa gawa raha hai aur koi financing isko theek nahi kar sakti.
when: Jab mahina busy tha par bank me kuch nahi bacha, aur aap jaanna chahte ho problem operation me hai ya financing me.
Jab aap apne business ko competitor se compare kar rahe ho aur wo ek number chahiye jo funding ko ignore kare.
Jab aap buyer ya lender ke liye tayyaar ho rahe ho aur core business ko alag dikhana chahte ho.
mistakes: Operating profit ki jagah net profit daal dena. Interest aur tax operating cost nahi hain, isliye margin kam dikhta hai.
Do company ka margin bina ye dekhe compare karna ki unme operating kya ginta hai. Ek marketing ko operating me rakhti hai, doosri one-off maanti hai.
Ek quarter ko trend maan lena. One-off cost aur seasonality se margin hilta rehta hai; direction par bharosa karo.

payback.what: CAC payback period batata hai ki customer ko jeetne me jo kharch hua, wo us customer ke profit ke kitne mahine me wapas aata hai. Ye LTV:CAC ratio ka cash-flow version hai: accha ratio bhi itna lamba payback chhupa sakta hai ki paisa profit se pehle khatam ho jaaye. Acquisition cost, per customer monthly revenue aur gross margin daaliye - kitne mahine, ye mil jaata hai. Barah mahine se kam payback se aap jaldi dobara invest kar sakte ho; teen saal matlab har naya customer us paise pe daanv hai jo der se aayega.
payback.formula: Payback Period (months) = CAC ÷ (Monthly Revenue per Customer × Gross Margin %). Customer jeetne me ₹5,000 lage, wo ₹1,000 mahina deta hai aur 40% margin rakhte ho toh payback ₹5,000 ÷ ₹400 = 12.5 mahine. Margin hi payback ko asli banata hai; sirf revenue pe wahi customer paanch mahine ka payback dikhata hai jo kabhi aata hi nahi.
when: Tay kar rahe ho ki acquisition pe kitna aggressive kharch karna hai.
Paisa raise kiya hai aur jaanna hai ki kitni jaldi naye customers me badlega.
Do segments compare kar rahe ho jinki payback speed alag hai.
mistakes: Denominator me revenue use karna gross-margin profit ke bajaye, jisse payback aadha dikhta hai.
Ye bhoolna ki lamba payback tabhi chalega jab funding ka paisa bank me pehle se ho.
Churn ignore karna - jo customer payback ke mahine se pehle chala gaya, wo cost kabhi wapas nahi karta.

percent.what: Percentage calculator us sabse aam money sawaal ka jawab deta hai: is number ka X% kitna hai, aur agar result itna hai toh woh kitne percent hai? Har discount, har tax rate, har growth figure aur har margin andar se percentage hi hai, isliye poori site isi tool par khadi hai. Jaal ye hai ki percentages jodte nahi jaise log sochte hain - 20% badhne ke baad 20% gire toh aap wahi nahi rehte, 4% neeche rehte ho.
percent.formula: Number ka percentage = Number × Percentage ÷ 100. ₹2,400 par 15% discount ₹360 hai, toh aap ₹2,040 dete ho. Ulta: agar 15% off ke baad ₹2,040 diye, toh original 2,040 ÷ 0.85 = ₹2,400 hai. Aur do numbers ke beech badlav = (New − Old) ÷ Old × 100, isse pata chalta hai ki woh 'bada' rise actually bada hai ya nahi.
when: Bill par discount ya tax check kar rahe ho.
Jaanna hai koi number kitne percent badha ya ghata.
Margin ya kisi total ka hissa nikaal rahe ho.
mistakes: Percentages ko simple numbers ki tarah jodna-ghatana. Ye compound hote hain, aur order maayne rakhta hai.
Naye number se rise nikaalna purane se nahi. Base badalne se jawab badal jaata hai.
Percentage points aur per cent ko same samajh lena. 4% se 6% jaana 2 percentage point ka rise hai par 50% ka increase.

pitchscore.what: Shark Tank pitch check aapke numbers ko un sawaalon par chalata hai jo sharks actually poochte hain, aur batata hai kaunse sawaalon par aapko grilling milegi. Shark Tank India par jaanch-paraakh kaafi consistent hai: aapki valuation kya hai aur kyun, revenue aur margins kya hain, customer paane mein kitna lagta hai, aur kitne mahine ka cash bacha hai? Jis pitch ke paas in chaaron ke saaf jawab hain, woh room mein tik jaati hai.
pitchscore.formula: Koi ek formula nahi hai - check ratios dekhta hai. Valuation vs revenue batata hai ask kitna mehnga hai. LTV vs CAC batata hai growth profitable hai ya nahi; 3:1 se neeche sharks push back karte hain. Runway mahino mein batata hai business ke paas kitna waqt hai. Gross margin batata hai ki product apni growth fund kar sakta hai ya nahi. ₹1 crore revenue par ₹10 crore valuation 10x multiple hai, aur pitch ko woh justify karna padta hai.
when: Pitch taiyaar kar rahe ho aur pehle apne kamzor numbers jaanna chahte ho.
Investor ne metrics maange hain aur unhe sanity-check karna hai.
Raise karne se pehle kya theek karna hai ye decide kar rahe ho.
mistakes: Valuation lekar aana jise support karne ke liye revenue nahi hai. Multiple sabse pehle poochha jaata hai.
CAC aur LTV pata na hona jab poocha jaaye, jisse lagta hai apna business nahi jaante.
Aisa burn rate batana jisse runway chhota nikle aur uske liye plan na ho.

ppf.what: PPF calculator dikhata hai ki aapki saalana Public Provident Fund contributions 15 saal ke lock-in mein kya banti hain, aur jawab zyadatar logon ki expectation se zyada hota hai kyunki PPF tax-free compound hota hai. Aap har saal ek fixed amount daalte ho, balance par interest milta hai jo poora exempt hai, aur maturity amount bhi tax-free - isse yeh India ke un gine-chune EEE instruments mein se ek banta hai. Keemat sabr hai: paisa 15 saal ke liye lock hai, aur yahi poora trade hai.
ppf.formula: Balance PPF rate par saalana compound hota hai har saal ki contribution par, aur maturity value 15 saal ke ant mein kul hoti hai. ₹1.5 lakh saalana 7.1% par 15 saal: maturity takreeban ₹40.7 lakh, jisme takreeban ₹22.5 lakh aapki khud ki contribution hai aur baaki tax-free interest. Financial year mein jaldi daalne se us paise par poore saal ka interest milta hai, isliye April March se behtar hai.
when: PPF aur equity SIP ke beech choose kar rahe ho long-term goal ke liye.
Aapki current saalana contribution maturity par kya banti hai ye jaanna hai.
80C deduction ke liye PPF use kar rahe ho aur poora picture dekhna hai, sirf tax saving nahi.
mistakes: March ki jagah April mein deposit karna. Us contribution par poore saal ka interest chala jaata hai.
PPF ke 7.1% ko equity fund ke long-run return se compare karna bina ye ginne ki PPF ka return guaranteed aur tax-free hai.
₹1.5 lakh saalana cap bhool jaana, jise ek account mein badhaya nahi ja sakta.

prepost.what:
Pre-Money & Post-Money Valuation term sheet ko waise hi leta hai jaise wo likha hota hai — naye paise se pehle company ki price, aur wo cheque khud — aur do numbers nikalta hai jo tay karte hain founder ke paas kya bachta hai. Pre-money matlab company naye paise ke bahar rehte hue kitne ki maani gayi; post-money matlab wahi value plus investment. Dono ke beech ka gap sirf ganit nahi hai: wo utna stake hai jo naya paisa kharidta hai.

Round band hone ke baad isi stake par bahas hoti hai. Agar pre-money ₹9 crore hai aur investor ₹1 crore lagata hai, to post-money ₹10 crore hua aur cheque ne 10% liya — poori company ka dasva hissa, purani company ka nahi. Jo founder sirf pre-money padhta hai wo maan leta hai ki naya investor ka hissa kahin aur se aayega, aur phir hairan hota hai jab kam uske apne percentage me hota hai. Tool dono valuations aur diya gaya equity ek hi line me dikhata hai taaki ye hairani na ho.
prepost.formula: Post-Money Valuation = Pre-Money Valuation + Investment Amount. Equity Given = Investment Amount ÷ Post-Money Valuation × 100. Pre-money (pre) aur investment (amt) daalo; tool dono jodkar post-money banata hai, phir investment ko us post-money se divide karke stake dikhata hai. ₹9 crore pre-money plus ₹1 crore cheque matlab ₹10 crore post-money aur 10% diya gaya. Stake hamesha post-money ke hisaab se naapa jaata hai, pre-money ke nahi.
when: Jab term sheet me pre-money figure ho aur aapko post-money aur diya gaya stake chahiye.
Jab aap soch rahe ho ki kam pre-money par zyada paisa uthana theek hai ya nahi, aur dekhna chahte ho kitna zyada company chala jaayega.
Jab aap simple cap table bana rahe ho aur stakes me todne se pehle post-money chahiye.
mistakes: Stake ko pre-money ke hisaab se naapna. Pre-money ka 10% company ka 10% nahi hota; investment khud post-money base ka hissa hai.
Pre-money ko poori company ki price samajh lena. Ye naye paise se pehle ki price hai, jo akele kam aur kam-kaam ki baat hai.
Cheque ko pre-money me jod dena lekin ye bhoolna ki founder ka apna stake bilkul usi equity se dilute hota hai jo naye investor ko mili.

propertyroi.what: Property ROI calculator us sawaal ka jawab deta hai jo doosra ghar kharidne wala aksar galat nikalta hai: is flat ne mujhe actually kitna kamaya? Do alag return hote hain aur dono confuse karna aasan hai. Ek cash hai - jo kiraya aapne liya. Doosra kagaz par - flat ki value kitni badhi. Sirf appreciation dekhkar property badi investment lagti hai, par cash mein kuch nahi mila ho sakta - aur tenant jaane ya EMI rukne par yahi maayne rakhta hai. Yeh calculator dono ek saath dikhata hai, un saalon ke hisaab se jitne aapne rakha.
propertyroi.formula: Total gain = (Sale Value − Purchase Price) + holding period ka kul kiraya. ROI = Total gain ÷ Purchase Price × 100, aur annualised figure isse saalon par baant deta hai. ₹60 lakh ka flat, 6 saal baad ₹85 lakh par becha, ₹1.2 lakh saalana kiraya: gain ₹25 lakh plus ₹7.2 lakh = ₹32.2 lakh, ₹60 lakh par - kul takreeban 54%, saalana takreeban 7.4%. Rental yield, matlab saalana kiraya ÷ purchase price, wahi number hai jise FD se compare karna chahiye.
when: Flat kiraye par hai aur jaan-na hai ki actually kitna return mil raha hai.
Doosri property aur FD ya debt fund ke beech choose karna hai.
Bechna hai aur price tay karne se pehle poora gain - cash aur appreciation dono - dekhna hai.
mistakes: Appreciation ginna aur kiraya bhool jaana, ya ulta. Return dono ko milaakar banta hai.
Jo paisa gaya woh bhool jaana - stamp duty, registration, brokerage, maintenance aur loan ka interest.
6% rental yield ko 7% FD se compare karna bina appreciation jode, jabki log property isi wajah se kharidte hain.

propertyvalue.what: Property valuation matlab aaj aapka flat, house ya plot kitne ka hai, iska estimate. Zyadatar ghar ke liye sabse seedha tareeka yahi hai: area jitna hai, usse locality ka actual per square foot rate multiply kar do. Banks, brokers aur buyers sab isi number se shuru karte hain. Asli bahas rate per square foot par hoti hai - 1,000 sq ft ka flat ek gali mein ₹80 lakh ka hai aur do kilometre door ₹1.6 crore ka, aur area wahi hai. Isliye yeh calculator sirf do numbers maangta hai.
propertyvalue.formula: Property Value = Area (sq ft) × Price per Sq Ft. 900 sq ft ka flat ₹7,500 per sq ft par ₹67.5 lakh. 1,400 sq ft ka flat ₹11,000 per sq ft par ₹1.54 crore. Ulta bhi kaam ka hai: agar broker 1,200 sq ft ke flat ka ₹1.2 crore maang raha hai, toh rate ₹10,000 per sq ft ban raha hai - ab isse aas-paas ke actual sold rates se compare kar lo. Yahi ek division overpriced listing pakad leti hai.
when: Flat dekh liya aur asking price ko locality ke per square foot rate se check karna hai.
Do localities compare kar rahe ho aur dono ko ek hi per-square-foot basis par laana hai.
Broker ne lump sum bola hai aur aap dekhna chahte ho ki usme rate per square foot kitna nikal raha hai.
mistakes: Built-up area use karna jab price carpet area par quote hui ho. Wahi flat carpet par 20% chhota lagta hai aur rate per square foot bina wajah zyada dikhta hai.
Asking rate ko market rate maan lena. Asking prices actual closing se upar hoti hain, kabhi 10% ya zyada.
Floor, building ki age aur facing ignore karna - ye ek hi building ke andar bhi rate badal dete hain.

rashi.what: Rashi matlab moon sign, aur Vedic astrology me yahi sign sabse zyada matter karta hai - Western sun sign se kaafi zyada. Chaand har rashi me lagbhag dhai din rehta hai, isliye ek hafte ke gap me paida do logon ki rashi alag ho sakti hai. Ye tool sirf aapki birth date se rashi ka andaaza lagata hai, aur date-only ganit ki imaandaar limit yahi hai: chaand har 54 ghante me rashi boundary cross karta hai, isliye boundary ke paas ki date dono taraf ja sakti hai. Page rashi ko traditional order me batata hai, Mesha se Meena tak, aur saaf likhta hai ki ye estimate kya tay kar sakta hai aur kya nahi.
rashi.formula: Chaand poora zodiac lagbhag 27.3 din me tay karta hai, yaani har rashi me takreeban 2.25 din. Ye tool aapki date se din nikaalta hai, usse baari-baari barah rashis par map karta hai - Mesha, Vrishabha, Mithuna, Karka, Simha, Kanya, Tula, Vrishchika, Dhanu, Makara, Kumbha, Meena - aur us din wali rashi dikhata hai. Yahan mahine ki tareekh chaand ki position ka stand-in hai. Sahi rashi ke liye birth time chahiye, kyunki chaand lagbhag har 54 ghante me rashi boundary cross karta hai.
when: Jaldi rashi chahiye aur sirf birth date yaad hai, time nahi.
Panchang ya rashi forecast padh rahe ho aur jaanna hai ki wo kis rashi ke liye likha hai.
Dost ke saath rashi compare kar rahe ho aur kisi ke paas birth record nahi hai.
mistakes: Date-only rashi ko final maan lena. Boundary ke ek din andar asli rashi ke liye birth time chahiye.
Rashi aur Western sun sign ko ek samajhna. Dono me barah naam hain, par bhasha aur dates alag.
Rashi estimate se muhurat, shaadi ya property timing tay karna. Uske liye jyotish se poori kundli chahiye.

rd.what: Recurring deposit har mahine ek hi rate par commitment hai, aur bank har instalment par us din se interest deta hai. 5,000 rupaye mahina 5 saal 7% par lagbhag 3.6 lakh banta hai, jisme 3 lakh aapka hi paisa hai. Ye deposits ka SIP jaisa hai, aur calculator ka kaam interest ko contributions se alag dikhana hai taaki return imaandaar lage.
rd.formula: Maturity = sum of P x (1 + r / 4)^(bache quarters), har monthly instalment par. Interest = Maturity - (P x mahine).
when: Aapko fixed-return monthly habit chahiye aur commit karne se pehle maturity jaanna hai.
3 saal ke goal ke liye RD ko debt mutual fund se compare kar rahe ho.
Aap dekhna chahte ho ki aakhri instalment pehli se kitna kamati hai - farak logon ko chauka deta hai.
mistakes: Advertised rate poore balance par lagne ki ummeed rakhna. Har instalment sirf utne hi time kamata hai jitna wo andar hai.
Instalment miss karke penalty na maan lena. Bank lagata hai, aur rate reset ho sakta hai.
10 saal ke goal ke liye RD use karna. Itne horizon par equity compounding usually jeet jati hai.

rentalyield.what: Rental Yield Calculator property ke rent ko uski cost ka annual percentage bana deta hai. Monthly rent ko 12 se guna karke saal ka rent nikalo, usko purchase price se divide karo aur 100 se guna karo. 50,00,000 ka ghar 20,000 monthly rent par saal ka 2,40,000 kamata hai, matlab gross yield 4.8%. Yeh percentage hi kaam ki cheez hai: do alag price wali properties ko ek hi scale par laata hai, aur property ko FD ya bond se compare karne deta hai.
rentalyield.formula: Annual rent = monthly rent x 12. Gross rental yield = annual rent / property price x 100. Tool base me purchase price leta hai, isliye rent same rehne par bhi price badhne se yield girta hai. Yeh gross yield hai: maintenance, property tax aur khaali pade hafte isme se nahi ghate, isliye asli net yield hamesha kam hota hai.
when: Jab aap do flats, alag price par, ek hi scale se compare kar rahe ho.
Jab aap dekhna chahte ho ki itne paise par rental FD se better hai ya nahi.
Jab aap dekhna chahte ho ki rent thoda kam hone par yield kitna badalta hai.
mistakes: Gross yield ko apna final return samajhna — maintenance aur vacancy pehle ghate hain.
Rent ko property price ke bajaye loan amount se divide karna.
Furnished flat ka yield bare shell se compare karna, price adjust kiye bina.

rentbuy.what: Rent vs Buy ek tay saal ke rent ko usi ghar ko khareedne ki cost se milata hai, loan ke bina. Rent side simple hai: monthly rent ko 12 se, phir compare karne wale saalon se guna karo. Buy side me home price plus ek baar ka upfront cost aata hai — stamp duty, registration, brokerage, shifting ka kharcha, jo wapas nahi aata. Tool home loan model nahi karta, isliye yeh chhota sawaal dekhta hai ki cash dene par kaunsi side chhoti padti hai.
rentbuy.formula: Total rent = monthly rent x 12 x years compared. Buy cost before loan = home price + upfront buy costs. Tool dono dikhata hai aur jo chhota ho usko lower cost kehta hai. EMI aur interest jaan-boojh kar chhod diye jaate hain, isliye buy figure day-one ka cash hai, poora holding cost nahi.
when: Jab aap rent par ho aur cash se khareedne ka break-even dekhna chahte ho.
Jab aapko purchase ka one-time cost chahiye, loan se alag.
Jab aap kisi ko samjha rahe ho ki kam rent bhi paanch saal me haar sakta hai.
mistakes: Buy figure ko poora ownership cost samajhna — loan interest usme nahi hai.
Paanch saal ka rent total ek ghar ki price se compare karna jise aap bees saal rakhoge.
Bhool jaana ki stamp duty aur registration upfront number me hain, price me nahi.

retention.what: Retention matlab kitne customers wapas aate hain; churn matlab kitne chhod dete hain. Dono milkar tay karte hain growth compound karegi ya leak karegi. Mahine ki shuruaat 1,000 customers se, aakhir bhi 1,000, aur beech me 100 naye aaye - matlab 100 purane gaye: retention 90%, churn 10%. Business har mahine customers jodta reh sakta hai aur phir bhi sikud sakta hai agar churn acquisition se zyada ho. Ye calculator dono dikhata hai, taaki leak bucket khaali hone se pehle dikh jaaye.
retention.formula: Retention % = (Customers at End − New Customers) ÷ Customers at Start × 100; Churn % = 100 − Retention %. 1,000 se shuru, 1,000 pe khatam, 100 naye: retained = 1,000 − 100 = 900, toh retention 90% aur churn 10%. Yahi ghatana zyadatar founders chhod dete hain - naye customers purane jaane ko chhupa dete hain, aur sirf calculation sach dikhati hai.
when: Subscription ya repeat-purchase business healthy hai ya nahi, ye naap rahe ho.
Retention pe invest karein ya acquisition pe, ye tay kar rahe ho.
Churn badalne ka saal bhar ke growth pe asar dekhna hai.
mistakes: Naye customers ko retention ginna, jisse gaye hue chhup jaate hain.
Churn mahine ka naapkar business ko saal ke numbers pe judge karna, ya ulta.
Chhote churn ko harmless maan lena - 5% mahina matlab saal me aadhi se zyada base gayi.

revmul.what: Revenue Multiple batata hai ki company ki valuation uski saalana revenue ka kitna guna hai. Agar business ₹1 crore kamata hai aur koi ₹5 crore de raha hai, to multiple 5x hai. Ye valuation ka sabse tez sanity check hai kyunki revenue par bahas nahi hoti — wo invoice par likha hota hai, kisi assumption sheet par nahi. Profit ke baare me ye kuch nahi batata, isliye isse margin ke saath hi padho.
revmul.formula: Revenue Multiple = Valuation ÷ Annual Revenue. Tool aapki daali valuation ko saalana revenue se divide karta hai aur jawab times me dikhata hai. 3x ka matlab hai buyer har ek rupaye ki saalana bikri par teen rupaye de raha hai. Koi bhi figure badlo to multiple badal jaata hai — yahi baat hai: wahi ₹5 crore ka price 2x par sasta hai aur 12x par mehenga.
when: Jab founder ke paas offer ya term sheet ho aur wo jaanna chahe ki price normal range me hai ya nahi.
Jab aap ek hi business ke do companies compare kar rahe ho aur dono ka sirf revenue figure available ho.
Jab aap apna asking price tay kar rahe ho aur chahte ho ki category me buyers jo multiple dete hain usse peeche chalo.
mistakes: Galat revenue lena. Buyer ka matlab hota hai pichhle barah mahine ya agle barah, aur badhti business me dono me 40% ka farak ho sakta hai — multiple uske saath hilta hai.
High multiple ko achhi khabar maan lena. 5% margin wali business par 10x revenue ka price, 30% margin wali par 3x se kharab hai.
Recurring aur one-off revenue mila dena. Subscription revenue ko project revenue se kaafi zyada multiple milta hai, isliye blended figure dono taraf ko galat batata hai.

roas.what: Return on Ad Spend batata hai ki ads pe kharch hue har rupee pe kitne rupee revenue wapas aaye. Ads se aayi revenue ko ad spend se divide karo: ₹20,000 ads se ₹1,00,000 revenue matlab ROAS 5x. Campaign chal raha hai ya nahi, ye jaanne ka ye sabse tez tareeka hai, par revenue profit nahi hai. Patli margin wale product pe 5x ROAS bhi cost of goods, shipping aur returns ke baad paisa kha sakta hai. ROAS se campaign screen karo, phir scale karne se pehle margin check karo.
roas.formula: ROAS = Revenue from Ads ÷ Ad Spend. ₹1,00,000 ÷ ₹20,000 = 5x. Isko break-even test banane ke liye 1 ko gross margin se divide karo: 25% margin pe product ki cost cover karne ke liye hi ROAS 4x se upar chahiye, profit se pehle. Low-margin product pe high ROAS bhi loss ho sakta hai.
when: Campaign scale karne layak hai ya nahi, ye check kar rahe ho.
Alag cost aur return wale channels compare kar rahe ho.
Agency ya media buyer ke liye target ROAS set kar rahe ho.
mistakes: Revenue-based ROAS ko profit maan lena - ye cost of goods, shipping aur returns ignore karta hai.
Alag margin wale products ka ROAS aapas me compare karna jaise number ek jaisa ho.
Achhe ROAS pe scale kar dena, ye check kiye bina ki extra orders fulfil ho sakte hain.

roce.what:
Return on Capital Employed wahi sawaal uthata hai jo ROI nahi uthata: is business me jo bhi paisa laga hai - aapka ho ya bank ka - wo kitni mehnat kar raha hai? Capital employed matlab shareholders' equity plus long-term debt, isliye ek bina-karz ki dukaan aur ek bhaari loan wali dukaan ek hi scale par aa jaati hain. Do business ka ROI same ho sakta hai aur ROCE bilkul alag, aur wo gap aam taur par udhaar ka hota hai.

Jab aap acquisition, nayi machine ya doosri branch ko pehle se lage paise se compare kar rahe ho, tab yahi tool kholo. Ye interest se pehle ka number hai: tool operating profit ko capital employed se divide karta hai aur wahin ruk jaata hai, kyunki paisa kahan se aaya yahi to dekhna hai.
roce.formula: ROCE = operating profit (EBIT) / capital employed x 100. Is tool me 'Operating Profit' ebit field hai aur 'Capital Employed' ce field. Capital employed matlab total assets minus current liabilities, jo shareholders' equity plus long-term debt ke barabar hai. Rs 4,50,000 operating profit par Rs 18,00,000 capital employed = 25%. Kyunki upar wala number interest aur tax se pehle nikalta hai, ROCE udhaar badalne se nahi hilta - isi wajah se alag-alag funded companies compare ho paati hain.
when: Jab do companies ka karz alag ho aur aap like-for-like return dekhna chahte ho.
Jab aap tay kar rahe ho ki nayi machine ya nayi branch business me lage paise se zyada kamayegi ya nahi.
Jab investor poochta hai ki company poori balance sheet ka kitna acha use kar rahi hai, sirf founders ke paise ka nahi.
mistakes: Numerator me interest ke baad ka profit daal dena. ROCE jaan-boojhkar EBIT leta hai taki karz number ko na chamkaye na dabaye; net profit ROE ka kaam hai.
Capital employed ke saath chhedchhad - short-term creditors do baar ghata dena, ya cash poori tarah hata dena - number uchhal jaata hai par asli me kuch nahi badalta.
Bahut kam capital employed wale business ka 200% ROCE dekh kar khush ho jaana. Jo firm sab kuch kiraye par leti hai wo 200% dikha sakti hai aur phir bhi kuch kharidne layak nahi hota.

roi.what:
Return on Investment sabse seedha return ka number hai: jo lagaya uske badle kitna wapas aaya? Tool net profit leta hai - har kharch ke baad, interest aur tax bhi - aur usko investment cost se divide karta hai. Rs 10,00,000 par Rs 1,00,000 profit matlab 10%. Yahan koi annualise nahi hota aur koi risk adjust nahi hota, isliye do projects ka same ROI tabhi compare ho sakta hai jab dono ne utna hi waqt liya ho.

Har us kharch par pehla filter yahi rakho jiske saath number juda ho: ad campaign, machine, course, dukaan ka fit-out. Ye jaan-boojhkar simple hai, aur yahi iski kamzori bhi - ye nahi batata ki 10% chhe mahine me aaya ya chhe saal me. Jab timing hi asli sawaal ho to payback ya CAGR nikalo.
roi.formula: ROI = net profit / investment cost x 100. Yahan 'Net Profit' profit field hai aur 'Investment Cost' inv field. Net profit wo hai jo goods, salary, ads, fees, interest aur tax ke baad bachta hai - revenue nahi, gross margin nahi. Rs 10,00,000 laga kar Rs 1,00,000 net profit = 10% ROI. Tool saal se divide nahi karta, isliye ek saal ka 10% aur paanch saal ka 10% is page par ek jaisa dikhta hai.
when: Jab aap ek ad campaign, machine ya course par paisa chhodne se pehle usko judge kar rahe ho.
Jab kai chhote kharche ka ek number me ranking chahiye aur sab me lagbhag same time lagta ho.
Jab koi ROI ka number bole aur aap unke profit aur cost se wo dobara nikal kar check karna chahte ho.
mistakes: Numerator me gross profit ya revenue daal dena, jisse 10% ROI 40% jaisa dikhne lagta hai.
Sale ke baad wale kharche chhod dena - GST, marketplace commission, returns, gateway fees - aur profit ka optimistic version dikha dena.
Chhe mahine ka 10% ROI aur paanch saal ka 10% ROI ek maan lena; tool annualise nahi karta, isliye aapko karna padega.

royalty.what: Royalty deal me investor equity ke badle ya uske saath-saath aapki revenue ka ek fixed percentage har mahine leta hai, jab tak tay amount wapas na ho jaye. Sharks ko ye pasand hai kyunki paisa jaldi wapas aata hai, aur founders ko kyunki ownership bahut kam jaati hai. Investment, royalty rate aur expected annual revenue daaliye - saal ki royalty aur kitne saal me wapas hoga, dikh jaata hai. Royalty equity me sasti hai par cash flow me mehngi - ye sales pe lagti hai, profit pe nahi.
royalty.formula: Annual Royalty = Expected Annual Revenue × Royalty Rate %; Payback Period (years) = Investment ÷ Annual Royalty. ₹1.8 crore revenue pe 18% royalty se investor ko saal ka ₹32.4 lakh milta hai, jo ₹4.5 crore investment ko ~14 saal me wapas karta hai. Sales badhein toh jaldi, slow saal me payback lamba ho jaata hai par royalty phir bhi chukni padti hai.
when: Shark bade equity stake ke bajaye royalty offer karta hai.
Ownership bachani hai aur mahine ki revenue se dena theek hai.
Royalty-heavy aur equity-heavy offers compare kar rahe ho.
mistakes: Sirf ownership dekhkar deal judge karna aur mahine ka cash bhool jaana.
Ye maan lena ki revenue hamesha badhegi, jisse payback sirf kaagaz pe chhota dikhta hai.
Ye bhoolna ki royalty sales pe chukti hai, loss wale mahine me bhi.

runrate.what: Run rate aapke sabse haal ke mahine ko lekar poochta hai ki agar har mahina waisa hi ho toh poora saal kaisa dikhega. Yeh tezi se badhte business ko describe karne ka sabse fast tareeka hai, aur khud ko bewakoof banane ka sabse aasan bhi. ₹25 lakh ka mahina ₹3 crore ka run rate deta hai, jo serious business lagta hai - jab tak dhyaan na do ki us mahine mein festive spike tha jo repeat nahi hoga. Run rate direction batane ke liye kaam ka number hai aur promise ke liye kharab, aur investors farq jaante hain.
runrate.formula: Annual Run Rate = Last Month's Revenue × 12. ₹25 lakh mahina ₹3 crore saalana. Jis business mein tez season hota hai, uske liye teen mahine ka average zyada imaandar hai: ₹25 lakh, ₹18 lakh aur ₹20 lakh ka average ₹21 lakh, toh run rate ₹2.52 crore hai, ₹3 crore nahi. Steady growth mein monthly figure lo, warna average.
when: Paisa raise kar rahe ho aur business ka current size batana hai.
Mahine-dar-mahine apni growth track kar rahe ho aur saalana view chahiye.
Apne run rate ko saal ke shuru mein set kiye target se compare karna hai.
mistakes: Festive mahine ka run rate saalana figure bana ke pesh karna. Jo monthly trend dekhega woh samajh jaayega.
Lumpy, contract-based revenue wale business par run rate lagana. Yeh us business ki tareef kar deta hai jisme mahine mein ek bada order aaya.
Revenue run rate ko profit run rate samajh lena. ₹3 crore revenue run rate par loss bhi ho sakta hai.

saas.what: ARPU, MRR aur ARR woh teen numbers hain jin par har subscription ya app business judge hota hai. MRR woh recurring revenue hai jo aap har mahine expect kar sakte ho, ARR wahi saalana bana hua, aur ARPU average revenue per user. Investors inhe lagbhag sabse pehle dekhte hain, kyunki recurring revenue one-off sales se kaafi zyada keemti hoti hai - isse forecast kiya ja sakta hai, aur customers rukne se ye compound hoti hai.
saas.formula: MRR = subscriptions se total monthly revenue. ARR = MRR × 12. ARPU = MRR ÷ Active Users. ₹8,00,000 monthly subscription revenue = ₹96,00,000 ARR. 2,000 active users ke saath ARPU ₹400 mahina. Do cheezein inhe hilati hain: naye customers MRR badhate hain, aur churn isse ghatata hai. Jo business MRR badha raha hai par har mahine 8% customers kho raha hai, woh chhedi hui balti bhar raha hai.
when: Paisa raise kar rahe ho aur MRR aur ARR sahi batana hai.
Do pricing plans compare kar rahe ho aur dekhna hai kaunsa ARPU badhata hai.
Track kar rahe ho ki growth asli hai ya sirf churn bhar rahi hai.
mistakes: One-off setup fees ya annual prepayments ko MRR ginna. Isme sirf recurring revenue aati hai.
Ek achhe mahine se ARR batana, current run rate se nahi.
ARPU dekhna par churn nahi. Zyada ARPU aur zyada churn ke saath business phir bhi sikud jaata hai.

savegoal.what: Savings Goal Planner batata hai ki aapke target tak pahunchne me kitne mahine lagenge, aapki abhi ki savings aur monthly amount ke hisaab se. Find out how many months it will take to reach a savings target. Ye ek simple calculation hai, lekin yahi ek number logon ko saving shuru karne me sabse zyada madad karta hai.
savegoal.formula: Mahine = (Goal minus ab tak bachaya) ÷ har mahine bachaya jaane wala amount. Agar monthly amount zero hai to jawab nahi milta — target kabhi nahi pahunchega. Ye tool byaaj nahi jodta, isliye ye ek saada, conservative andaaza hai; agar aap paisa aisi jagah rakhte ho jahan return milta hai, to asli samay isse kam lagega.
when: Jab aap kisi bade target ke liye saving plan bana rahe ho — phone, trip, down payment.
Jab aap dekhna chahte ho ki monthly amount thoda badhane se kitne mahine bach jaate hain.
Jab aap ek naya recurring kharch karne se pehle apne plan par asar dekhna chahte ho.
mistakes: Ye maan lena ki jo amount aaj bacha rahe ho wo har mahine possible hoga.
Byaaj ya return ko plan me jod dena jab aap paisa savings account me hi rakhte ho.
Target ko bina emergency fund banaye poori saving usi me daal dena.

simpledisc.what: Discount Calculator batata hai ki kisi price par diya gaya percentage off asli me kitna paisa bachata hai. Original price aur discount daalo, aur tool do cheezein dikhata hai: kitne rupaye bache aur final kitna dena padega. Yahi number decide karta hai ki sale sach me faydemand hai ya nahi — sirf percentage nahi, kyunki dukaan wahi dikhati hai jo bada lagta hai.
simpledisc.formula: Bachat = original price × discount ÷ 100 (`price` × `disc` ÷ 100). Final price = original minus bachat (`price` − saving). ₹2,000 par 25% discount me bachat ₹500 aur final price ₹1,500 hota hai. Do discount ek ke baad ek lagte hain to unhe jodte nahi — 30% phir 20% me aap price ka 0.7 × 0.8 = 0.56 dete ho, matlab 44% off, 50% nahi.
when: Marketplace ya dukaan flat percentage off dikhaye aur aap decide karne se pehle rupaye me amount jaanna chahein.
Do sale prices compare kar rahe ho jahan discount aur original price dono alag hain.
Coupon kisi chalti sale ke upar lage aur aapko asli final price jaanna ho.
mistakes: Do discounts ko jod dena. 30% discount ke baad 20% matlab 44% off, 50% nahi, kyunki doosra discount pehle se kam hue price par lagta hai.
Discount ko final price ka hissa maan lena. Percentage original marked price se ghata jaata hai; price girne ke baad wahi rupaye bacha hua price ka bada percentage ban jaate hain.
Alag alag prices par sirf discount percentage compare karna. ₹2,000 par 40% se ₹800 bachte hain, jo ₹1,000 par 50% ke ₹500 se zyada hai.

simpleint.what: Simple interest sirf mool amount par lagta hai, kamaye gaye interest par kabhi nahi. 1,00,000 rupaye 10% par 3 saal me 30,000 kamata hai - flat, har saal, usi 1,00,000 par. Usi terms par compound interest 33,100 kamata hai. Teen saal me 3,100 ka farak chhota hai aur tees saal me bahut bada, isliye kaun sa lagta hai ye jaanna rate se zyada zaroori hai.
simpleint.formula: Interest = Principal x Rate x Time / 100. Total = Principal + Interest. Saal se kam ke liye Time = mahine / 12.
when: Koi lender flat rate bolta hai aur aapko reducing-balance loan se compare karne ke liye simple-interest number chahiye.
Aap kisi dost ya rishtedaar ko udhaar de rahe ho aur rupees me saaf number chahiye.
Aap aisi FD ya bond coupon check kar rahe ho jo simple interest deti hai.
mistakes: Flat rate ko loan ki asli cost maan lena. Reducing balance par flat 10% lagbhag 18% ke barabar hota hai.
Lambi period par simple aur compound mix kar dena. 10 saal me farak chhota nahi hota.
Threshold se upar interest par TDS bhoolna, jo actually milne wali raqam kam kar deta hai.

sip.what: SIP matlab har mahine ek fixed amount mutual fund me daalna. Calculator ka poora point compounding hai: 10,000 rupaye mahina 20 saal 12% par 24 lakh ka contribution nahi, lagbhag 99 lakh banta hai, aur usme se teen-chauthai wo growth hai jo aapne kabhi jama hi nahi ki. Calculator aapka paisa aur growth alag dikhata hai, aur yahi number logon ko SIP shuru karwata hai.
sip.formula: Future Value = P x [((1 + i)^n - 1) / i] x (1 + i), jahan P monthly amount, i monthly rate (annual / 12 / 100) aur n instalments. Contribution = P x n; Growth = Future Value - Contribution.
when: Aap SIP 5,000 rupaye badhane ka soch rahe ho aur 20 saal ka farak dekhna chahte ho.
Aapko jaanna hai ki jo afford kar sakte ho usse goal kitne saal me pura hoga.
10% aur 12% fund me choose kar rahe ho aur dekhna chahte ho ki risk ke layak gap hai ya nahi.
mistakes: Fund ke pichhle saal ke return ko assumption bana lena. SIP long-run average par plan hoti hai, pichhle saal ke best par nahi.
Girte market me SIP band kar dena - aur yahi waqt hai jab har rupee par sabse zyada units milte hain.
Expense ratio ignore karna. 1% zyada ratio 20 saal ke corpus ka lagbhag dasva hissa kha jata hai.

split.what:
Bill Splitter ek shared amount ko paid karne wale logon ki ginti se divide karta hai, aur bas itna hi. Ye table ke aakhri do minute ka tool hai: bill par total likha hai, chaar log pay kar rahe hain, har ek ko chauthai dena hai. Ganit sirf ek division hai, isliye asli fayda maths me nahi - fayda ye hai ki per-head number pehle hi pata ho, isse pehle ki koi apne mann me rounding kar ke numbers alag-alag kar de.

Ye jaan-boojhkar simple case ke liye hai. Ye tay nahi karta ki paneer kisne order kiya, tip nahi jodta, aur service charge wale bill ko dobara split nahi karta. Yahi iski khoobi hai: barabar ka split hi wo split hai jo jhagda khatam karta hai, aur har uneven hisaab baad me aasani se set ho jaata hai jab equal share saamne aa jaata hai.
split.formula: Har banda deta hai total bill / number of people. Is tool me 'Total Bill' total field hai aur 'Number of People' people field. Rs 1,000 aur 4 log = Rs 250 per head. Jab total barabar na bante - Rs 1,000 aur 3 log - tool Rs 333.33 dikhata hai, aur saaf tareeka ye hai ki ek banda thode paise kha le ya sab thoda upar round karke difference tip me chhod dein.
when: Jab group dinner ya trip khatam ho aur bill wahin settle karna ho.
Jab roommates har mahine ka shared bijli ya grocery ka bill barabar baantte hain.
Jab co-founders ya chhoti team shared subscription ya taxi fare baantti hai.
mistakes: Pre-tax subtotal split karke bill par chhapa GST aur service charge bhool jaana.
Aane wale logon ki ginti se divide karna, un logon ki nahi jo pay kar rahe hain, jab kisi ko treat kiya ja raha ho.
Har share neeche round kar dena aur aakhri banda shortfall me chhod dena; upar round karo, ya ek banda thode rupees le le.

stampduty.what: Stamp duty calculator woh paisa nikalta hai jo property register karne ke din sarkar ko dena padta hai, aur ye takreeban hamesha budget se zyada hota hai. Stamp duty transaction par state tax hai aur registration uske naam karane ki fee; dono milaakar zyadatar states mein property value ka takreeban 6% se 8% ban jate hain, aur kuch mein 10% se upar. ₹80 lakh ke flat par ye ₹5 lakh se ₹8 lakh hai, ek saath dena padta hai, aur loan mein add nahi hota. Yeh calculator dono charges aur woh total dikhata hai jo sub-registrar office le jaana hai.
stampduty.formula: Stamp duty = Property Value × Stamp Duty Rate, aur Registration = Property Value × Registration Rate. Kharidne ki kul cost = Property Value + Stamp Duty + Registration. ₹80 lakh ka flat, 6% stamp duty aur 1% registration: ₹80 lakh + ₹4.8 lakh + ₹80,000 = us din ₹85.6 lakh. Dhyan rahe, kuch states agreement value aur circle rate mein se zyada par duty lagati hain, toh sarkar ka apna floor price bill badha sakta hai.
when: Property register karne wale ho aur us din ka exact cash pata karna hai.
Do states ya do sheher compare kar rahe ho aur transaction cost budget badal deti hai.
Purchase ki asli all-in cost nikaalni hai, sirf seller ka bataya price nahi.
mistakes: Price ka budget rakhna aur duty bhool jaana - ₹80 lakh ke flat par ye kai lakh zyada hota hai.
Stamp duty sab jagah same maan lena. Yeh state subject hai - state, buyer (auraton par kabhi kam) aur property type ke hisaab se badalta hai.
Ye bhool jaana ki stamp duty home loan mein finance nahi hoti, isliye apna cash chahiye.

takehome.what: Take-home wo hai jo employer TDS, employee ka PF share aur professional tax kaatne ke baad bank me aata hai. CTC aur take-home ka gap zyada logon ki expectation se bada hota hai - 12 lakh CTC par monthly credit aksar 1,00,000 se zyada 80,000 ke aas-paas hota hai, kyunki employer ka PF aur gratuity CTC number ke andar hote hain par aapke haath me nahi aate. Calculator ye ghatav line by line karta hai.
takehome.formula: Take-home = Gross Salary - Employee PF (basic ka 12%) - Professional Tax - TDS. Gross = CTC - Employer PF - Gratuity - doosre retirals. Phir 75,000 rupaye standard deduction ke baad taxable gross par TDS nikalta hai.
when: Offer letter saamne hai aur do CTC ko monthly in-hand par compare karna hai.
Negotiation chal rahi hai aur 1 lakh CTC badhne par haath me kitna aayega ye jaanna hai.
Aap check karna chahte ho ki is saal purana ya naya tax regime zyada deta hai.
mistakes: Bade variable bonus wali CTC ko bina bonus wali se compare karna. Bonus monthly cash nahi hai.
Ye bhoolna ki employer PF CTC ke andar hai. Wo aapka paisa hai, par is mahine account me nahi.
Employer ka deducted TDS ko final tax maan lena. Wo estimate hai, aur March ka true-up asli hota hai.

tam.what: TAM, SAM aur SOM market size ko teen layer me todta hai: poora market (TAM), jise aap asli me serve kar sakte ho (SAM), aur jitna aap sach me jeet sakte ho (SOM). The total market, the part you can realistically reach, and the part you can actually win. Investors yahi poochte hain jab wo kehte hain 'market kitna bada hai', aur ek mota number dena unhe sabse jaldi shak me daalta hai.
tam.formula: TAM nikalne ka sabse saaf tarika bottom-up hai: kitne possible customers hain, guna ek customer saal me kitna kharch karta hai. SAM matlab wahi market, lekin aapke geography, product aur price band tak seemit. SOM matlab realistic share jo aap kuch saal me le sakte ho, aam taur par SAM ka ek chhota percentage. Top-down numbers (jaise 'India ka retail market 100 lakh crore hai') impress karte hain par kisi kaam ke nahi hote.
when: Jab aap pitch deck ka market-size slide bana rahe ho.
Jab aap naya product launch karne se pehle dekhna chahte ho ki opportunity kitni badi hai.
Jab aap investors ke 'TAM kitna hai' wale sawaal ke liye taiyaar ho rahe ho.
mistakes: Top-down TAM dikhana. Bada number acha lagta hai par sawaal khada karta hai.
TAM me apne aap ko market ka 1% maan lena, bina ye bataye ki wo 1% kaise aayega.
SAM ko ignore karke sirf TAM bolna, jab investor SAM aur SOM ke baare me poochta hai.

tip.what: Tip Calculator batata hai kitna tip chhodna hai aur bill tip jodne ke baad kitna banta hai. Bill aur percentage daalo, tool tip amount aur total — jo aap actually dete ho — dono deta hai. Cash de rahe ho, doston me split kar rahe ho, ya bill apni expectation se check kar rahe ho, tab yahi total kaam aata hai.
tip.formula: Tip amount = bill × tip percentage ÷ 100 (`bill` × `tip` ÷ 100). Total = bill + tip amount (`bill` + tip). ₹1,000 ke bill par 10% me tip ₹100 aur aap ₹1,100 dete ho. Pre-tax bill par tip dena ho to pre-tax figure daalo — percentage usi number par lagta hai jo bill field me hai.
when: Restaurant me ho aur bina dimaag me ganit kiye ek theek, round amount chhodna ho.
Bill par service charge pehle se ho aur aap dekhna chahein ki extra tip kitna jodega.
Bill split kar rahe ho aur har bande ka bill plus tip ka hissa chahiye.
mistakes: Total par tip dena, bill par nahi. Agar daala hua number pehle se tip shaamil hai, to percentage dobara lagane se tip double ho jaata hai.
Service charge pehle se ho aur upar se phir tip chhod dena. Service charge hi tip hai; aur dene se pehle bill check karo.
Bill split karke har hisse par alag tip dena. Poora tip ek baar nikalo, phir total baanto, warna har hisse ka rounding tip badha deta hai.

utilization.what: Utilization rate batata hai ki aapki team ke paid ghanton me se kitne ghante asli billable client kaam me gaye. Agar team ko 1,600 ghante ke liye pay kiya aur 1,200 ghante bill hue, to utilization 75% hai - baaki 25% internal meetings, admin, pitching aur training me gaya, jo aapki cost hai par invoice nahi hoti. Ye calculator billable ghante ko available ghanton se divide karke percentage deta hai, taki dikhe ki payroll ka kitna hissa asli me kam raha hai.
utilization.formula: Utilization rate = billable ghante / available ghante x 100. Available ghante wo hain jin ke liye aapne team ko pay kiya: logon ki sankhya x hafte ke ghante x hafte. 1,600 available me se 1,200 bill ho to rate = 1,200 / 1,600 x 100 = 75%. Tool yahi percentage deta hai. Isko har vyakti aur har mahine track karo, saal me ek baar nahi, kyunki koi ek banda lagataar 95% par ho to wo resign karne wala hai, star nahi.
when: Jab aap retainer ka price set kar rahe ho aur jaanna chahte ho ki team ko cover karne ke liye kitne billable ghante chahiye.
Jab mahina bhara laga par profit patla nikla, aur dekhna hai ki payroll ka kitna hissa invoice hua.
Jab hire karne ka soch rahe ho, kyunki current utilization batata hai ki team me spare capacity hai ya nahi.
mistakes: Har kaam ke ghante ko billable maan lena. Internal meetings, admin aur pitching wo ghante hain jin ke liye pay kiya par bill nahi hua.
100% utilization ke peeche bhagna. 70-80% ke aas paas theek hai; 95% par tikayi team burnout hokar chhod deti hai.
Available ghante 40-ghante hafte se nikalna jab team asli me 45 ghante kaam karti hai. Denominator wahi hai jiska aapne pay kiya.

wc.what: Working capital wo paisa hai jo business ke rozana kaam me bandha hota hai: shelf par stock, plus jo customers aapko dena hai, minus jo aap suppliers ko dena hai. Business profitable ho sakta hai aur phir bhi cash khatam ho jaye, kyunki profit accounting ka number hai aur working capital cash ka. Calculator teen lines ko ek figure aur ek cycle length me badal deta hai, taaki dikhe ki aapka paisa kitne din ghoom kar wapas aata hai.
wc.formula: Working Capital = Current Assets - Current Liabilities. Cash Conversion Cycle = Days Inventory + Days Receivable - Days Payable.
when: Aap profitable ho par bank account baar-baar zero hota hai aur dekhna hai paisa kahan baitha hai.
Customer 60 din ki terms maangta hai aur aapko uska cost price karna hai.
Aap working-capital limit ke liye apply kar rahe ho aur bank jo number poochega wo chahiye.
mistakes: Sirf stock ginna aur receivables bhoolna. Slow-paying customers slow stock se zyada cash bandhte hain.
Negative working capital ko hamesha kharab maanna. Prepaid plans wale subscription business ke liye ye healthy hai.
Cycle length ignore karna. 50 lakh 90 din ke liye bandha aur wahi raqam 15 din ke liye - do alag business hain.

zodiac.what: Western zodiac sign aapki birth date aur us din sooraj ki position se tay hota hai, isliye yahi ek sign hai jo sirf date se nikal jaata hai. Barah signs ka calendar har saal same chalta hai - Aries lagbhag 21 March, Cancer lagbhag 21 June - leap year me ek din ka farq aata hai. Ye tool aapki date ka sign dikhata hai aur wahi exact range bhi likhta hai jo usne use ki, taki cusp wala birthday guess na ho, settle ho jaye.
zodiac.formula: Har sign ka calendar me ek fixed band hai: Capricorn 22 December se 19 January, Aquarius 20 January se 18 February, Pisces 19 February se 20 March, Aries 21 March se 19 April, Taurus 20 April se 20 May, Gemini 21 May se 20 June, Cancer 21 June se 22 July, Leo 23 July se 22 August, Virgo 23 August se 22 September, Libra 23 September se 22 October, Scorpio 23 October se 21 November, aur Sagittarius 22 November se 21 December. Tool aapke month aur day ko in boundaries se compare karta hai aur wahi sign deta hai jiske band me date aati hai.
when: Horoscope ke liye sun sign chahiye aur sirf date hai.
Birthday cusp par hai aur jaanna hai ki date akeli kis sign ki taraf ishara karti hai.
Koi profile zodiac sign maang raha hai aur chart lookup nahi karna.
mistakes: Cusp wale birthday ko pakka maan lena. Boundary ke ek din andar sign birth time par depend karta hai.
Vedic sawaal ke liye Western sign use karna. Rashi chaand se chalti hai, sooraj se nahi.
Ye maan lena ki date ranges kabhi nahi hilti. Leap year boundaries ko lagbhag ek din khiska deta hai.
